# Oncology Areas of Interest

**IMPORTANT:** Pfizer has implemented application windows for unsolicited requests. Please [click
here][94] to view the Application and Batched Review Cycles.

Qualified researchers are invited to submit investigator-sponsored research (ISR) proposals,
according to the guidance and instructions found on the Pfizer ISR portal at
[www.Pfizer.com/ISR][95]. All proposals must be submitted via the ISR submission portal. An ISR
proposal requesting Pfizer support (e.g., funding and/or drug supply) is not a guarantee of
acceptance or approval of that proposal. Decisions on support for ISR submissions are made by the
applicable Pfizer Global Review Committee. A formal notification regarding the status of your
application will be sent once a decision is reached. Pfizer support will only be extended upon the
execution of an ISR agreement. For any questions, please send an email to [[email protected]][96].

Oncology compounds are listed below alphabetically. For each compound, the areas of interest are
listed in order of medical and scientific unmet need.
* axitinib

Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma (RCC)
* First Line (1L) Immuno-oncology (IO) combinations with supporting evidence
* Efficacy/Safety for combinations with IO post-1L
* Efficacy/Safety for sequencing post-1L
* TKI+IO mechanistic data
* Real World Data (RWD) studies

Non-RCC: Areas of high unmet medical need with strong evidence supporting the use of
anti-angiogenic therapies alone or in combination
* binimetinib

**Pfizer is accepting proposals for Investigator Sponsored Research with binimetinib from US,
Canada, Latin America, Africa and the Middle East. Organizations interested in sponsoring research
studies in South Korea or Japan should apply to Ono Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd. Organizations
interested in sponsoring research in Israel should apply to Medison. Organizations interested in
sponsoring research in all other geographies not noted above should apply to Pierre Fabre. **

**BRAF V600E/K mutant melanoma (in combination with encorafenib):**
* studies incorporating real world data on real world use including: treatment patterns and
outcomes, factors for treatment choices, sub-populations, and unmet needs under the current
treatment landscape
* molecular characterization of response/resistance to BRAF inhibition in melanoma

**Out of scope**
* studies in adjuvant setting
* combinations with immuno-oncology agents
* binimetinib as a single agent
* alternative routes of administration
* studies targeting NRAS mutations
* brentuximab vedotin

**Non-ALCL PTCL**
* Novel combinations in AITL and PTCL-NOS subtypes

**Large B-cell lymphoma (LBCL)**
* Novel combinations in 2L+ R/R LBCL

**Out of Scope**
* Combinations with unapproved agents
* Frontline DLBCL
* Classical Hodgkin Lymphoma
* Anaplastic large cell lymphoma (ALCL) or cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (CTCL)
* Non-ALCL PTCL outside of AITL and PTCL-NOS
* Follicular lymphoma (FL)
* Marginal zone lymphoma (MZL)
* Mantle cell lymphoma (MCL)
* Non-hematologic malignancies

To apply for Investigator Sponsored Research outside the US and Canada, please visit the [Takeda
Investigator-Sponsored Research portal][97].
* dacomitinib

Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (mNSCLC)
* Real world evidence (RWE) studies in first-line (1L) EGFR mutant mNSCLC including studies
focused on EGFR exon 21 L858R mutations from Latin America, Africa, Middle East, and Asian
countries (except Japan)

**Out of Scope:**
* Unselected NSCLC
* HER2 NSCLC and other HER2 driven tumors
* Post-EGFR TKI use including post osimertinib
* Immunotherapy combinations
* Establishing and validating new EGFR testing methods
* EGFR driven tumors (excluding NSCLC)
* Adjuvant setting
* elranatamab

**Relapsed-Refractory Multiple Myeloma (RRMM)**
* Effectiveness and safety outcomes
* Sequencing optimization
* Combination strategies with other treatment agents

**Newly Diagnosed Multiple Myeloma (NDMM)**
* Optimal use in induction treatment
* Consolidation strategies post-induction
* Tailored regimens for unfit/frail patients
* Combination with standard-of-care treatments and novel agents

**Priorities Across MM Lines of Treatment**
* Optimizing treatment duration and dosing
* Outpatient and at-home administration
* Monitoring and mitigation of infections, CRS, ICANS, and viral reactivation
* Response and progression markers

**Within and Beyond Plasma Cell Dyscrasias**
* Extramedullary Disease
* Plasma-Cell Leukemia
* Waldenstrom Macroglobulinemia, other Lymphoproliferative diseases, and plasma cell dyscrasias.
* encorafenib

**Pfizer is accepting proposals for Investigator Sponsored Research with encorafenib from US,
Canada Latin America, Africa and the Middle East. Organizations interested in sponsoring research
studies in South Korea or Japan should apply to Ono Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd. Organizations
interested in sponsoring research in Israel should apply to Medison. Organizations interested in
sponsoring research in all other geographies not noted above should apply to Pierre Fabre.**

**BRAF V600E/K mutant unresectable or metastatic melanoma (in combination with binimetinib):**
* studies incorporating real world data on real world use including: treatment patterns and
outcomes, factors for treatment choices, sub-populations, and unmet needs under the current
treatment landscape
* molecular characterization of response/resistance to BRAF inhibition in melanoma

**Out of scope**
* studies in adjuvant setting
* combinations with immuno-oncology agents
* encorafenib as a single agent
* alternative routes of administration
* studies targeting NRAS mutations

**BRAF V600E mutant metastatic colorectal cancer (CRC):**
* treatment sequencing strategies
* molecular responses to encorafenib (e.g., ctDNA, molecular profile)
* studies incorporating real world data on real world use including: treatment patterns, outcomes
and unmet needs under the current treatment landscape
* studies addressing encorafenib resistance (e.g., re-challenge, novel rational combinations)
* neoadjuvant studies
* studies incorporating patient reported outcomes or patient preference

**Out of scope**
* encorafenib as a single agent
* alternative routes of administration
* Non-V600E BRAF mutant CRC
* tumor-agnostic approaches with encorafenib
* enfortumab vedotin

To apply for Investigator Sponsored Research in the United States, please visit the [Astellas
Investigator-Sponsored Research portal][98].

Muscle Invasive Bladder Cancer, locally advanced/metastatic Urothelial Carcinoma (MIBC, la/mUC)
* Adverse event prevention, treatment and mitigation
* Treatment patterns upon progression on EV + P for la/mUC and MIBC
* Retreatment in patients previously exposed to enfortumab vedotin
* Combinations*/sequences with targeted therapies that have evidence of monotherapy activity and
safety in the relevant tumor type (la/mUC and MIBC)
* Health economics and outcomes studies evaluating real world patterns of retreatment in UC and
MIBC
* Nectin-4 expressing tumors with scientific rationale / unmet need

**For combination regimens, the enfortumab vedotin (EV) ISR program will consider EV drug supply
and partial funding. The EV ISR program will not supply drug for the other therapies in the
combination.*

*Nectin-4 expression testing is not required for Urothelial Carcinoma (if Nectin-4 testing is
desired by investigator for UC, then testing required via separate agreement with Q2 Solutions).
For non-UC tumors Nectin-4 expression testing required unless there is sufficient evidence to
support Nectin-4 expression in the tumor being studied. {Nectin-4 testing for non-UC tumors does
not need to be done by Q2 Solutions}.*

*Research for EV duplicative with Muscle Invasive Bladder Cancer, including bladder sparing
approaches will not be considered at this time*
* inotuzumab ozogamicin

**Exploration of role of Inotuzumab in front-line treatment of ALL***
* Studies incorporating comparator to SOC
* Studies expanding on existing evidence

Inotuzumab in combination with novel CD19 bispecific antibodies

* InO in combination with highly intensive chemotherapy are out of scope
* lorlatinib

**ALK+ Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (ALK+ NSCLC):**
* Generate RWE on 1L lorlatinib outcomes to further define effectiveness/safety/PRO and adherence
* Effective use of proactive and early AE management and correlation with patients’ outcomes
* Describe safety profile in pts with comorbidities (mental illness, CV disease, Obesity)
* Evidence to predict AEs with lorlatinib including CNS AEs and weight gain
* Define optimal sequencing after lorlatinib in 1L in the real-world
* Defining 1L lorlatinib ALK resistance patterns
* Identify predictive factors for early regressors and long-term responders on 1L lorlatinib and
explore treatment intensification strategies in 1L
* Understand impact of different starting dose strategies on efficacy and AEs rates
* Explore lorlatinib in early setting: as neo-adjuvant treatment or in unresectable stage III ALK+
NSCLC
* Evidence to address the lack of H2H data vs next generation ALK TKIs
* Proof of concept of combinations with lorlatinib
* Paediatric studies

**Out of Scope**
* Establishing and validating new ALK or ROS testing methods
* Adjuvant NSCLC

# Working to Transform Treatment for People Living with Autoimmune Diseases through a Unique
# Disease-modifying Therapy

At SAB BIO, our mission is to dramatically redefine what it means to be diagnosed with Type 1
Diabetes by developing a medicine to change the course of disease, not just treat symptoms.

## The Constant Management of Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) Calls for Treatment Options that Address the
## Underlying Cause of Disease

The chronic burden of type 1 diabetes is multifaceted, impacting a person’s physical and mental
well-being. Managing symptoms and potentially severe complications takes its toll on patients and
caregivers alike, and it is clear there is an urgent need for treatment options that can delay the
onset of T1D or modify the disease trajectory.

## SAB BIO’s Lead Asset, SAB-142, Is a Disease-Modifying Therapy That Can Potentially Delay
## Progression of T1D

Unlike insulin or other approaches to symptom management, our work is focused on addressing the
underlying cause of T1D: an over-reactive immune response that causes the immune system to
mistakenly attack insulin-producing beta cells in the pancreas. SAB-142 is a treatment option that
could help preserve beta cell function over time.

all_classified.company_summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific is a leading provider of scientific instruments, reagents, and consumables, dedicated to advancing research and healthcare. The company offers a diverse range of products and services, including antibodies, cell culture solutions, mass spectrometers, and lab instrument services, catering to various sectors such as biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, clinical diagnostics, and industrial applications. With a commitment to innovation and quality, Thermo Fisher supports scientists and researchers in their quest to accelerate scientific discovery and improve patient outcomes.

# Overview

[Overview]

## About us

As a global CRDMO (Contract Research, Development and Manufacturing Organization) with operations
across Asia, Europe, and North America, we provide global pharmaceutical services with innovators to
turn scientific discoveries into real-world therapies. Through its unique business models, WuXi
AppTec’s integrated, end-to-end solutions include chemistry drug CRDMO, biology discovery,
preclinical testing and clinical research services, helping customers improve the productivity of
advancing healthcare products in a cost-effective and efficient way. Our fully integrated platform
supports every stage of the drug development journey—from early drug discovery and preclinical
testing to clinical development and commercial manufacturing. Since we started in 2000, doing the
right thing for patients is behind everything we do. Trusted by customers across over 30 countries,
we help accelerate timelines to bring breakthrough treatments to the patients who need them most.
What drives each one of us is simple: a shared vision that every drug can be made, and every disease
can be treated.

## Services

# Overview

WuXi AppTec's broad and integrated portfolio of services enables our customers and partners in the
pharmaceutical, biotech and medical device industries worldwide to research, develop, discover and
produce innovative healthcare products quickly and effectively.
[Overview]
WuXi AppTec's broad and integrated portfolio of services enables our customers and partners in the
pharmaceutical, biotech and medical device industries worldwide to research, develop, discover and
produce innovative healthcare products quickly and effectively.
[Biology]
Biology
WuXi Biology provides a full spectrum of services and solutions to support stand-alone and
integrated projects, from target discovery to candidate selection and into the clinic. Our
world-class discovery platform is backed by nearly 3000 scientists, offering expertise in all major
disease areas and target classes, across all therapeutic modalities. From small molecules, peptides,
oligonucleotides to biologics, our state-of-the-art services, quick study launches and fast
turnaround times meet the diverse needs of our clients.
[LEARN MORE ][16]
[Small Molecule (CRDMO)]
Small Molecule (CRDMO)
We deliver small molecule solutions that are as powerful as they are personalized. From discovery to
market, our integrated CRDMO model simplifies your journey, providing the speed, quality and agility
your products and patients deserve—because we care, and we deliver.
[LEARN MORE ][17]
[Drug R&D Testing]
Drug R&D Testing
WuXi AppTec’s Laboratory Testing Division provides comprehensive, globally integrated CRDMO-enabling
solutions for pharmaceutical companies advancing small molecules, biologics, and emerging
therapeutic modalities. The division delivers end-to-end DMPK services, safety assessments, and
bioanalytical support throughout the development pipeline. With extensive experience in novel
compound classes including PROTACs, oligonucleotides, and ADCs, the team combines scientific
expertise, deep regulatory insight, and operational agility to accelerate drug development
timelines.
[LEARN MORE ][18]
[TIDES CRDMO]
TIDES CRDMO
Meeting complex challenges with precise solutions. We simplify TIDES drug development by providing
discovery, development and the entire manufacturing supply chain in one world-class organization.

# Overview

[Overview]

## About us

As a global CRDMO (Contract Research, Development and Manufacturing Organization) with operations
across Asia, Europe, and North America, we provide global pharmaceutical services with innovators to
turn scientific discoveries into real-world therapies. Through its unique business models, WuXi
AppTec’s integrated, end-to-end solutions include chemistry drug CRDMO, biology discovery,
preclinical testing and clinical research services, helping customers improve the productivity of
advancing healthcare products in a cost-effective and efficient way. Our fully integrated platform
supports every stage of the drug development journey—from early drug discovery and preclinical
testing to clinical development and commercial manufacturing. Since we started in 2000, doing the
right thing for patients is behind everything we do. Trusted by customers across over 30 countries,
we help accelerate timelines to bring breakthrough treatments to the patients who need them most.
What drives each one of us is simple: a shared vision that every drug can be made, and every disease
can be treated.

# Overview

WuXi AppTec's broad and integrated portfolio of services enables our customers and partners in the
pharmaceutical, biotech and medical device industries worldwide to research, develop, discover and
produce innovative healthcare products quickly and effectively.
[Overview]
WuXi AppTec's broad and integrated portfolio of services enables our customers and partners in the
pharmaceutical, biotech and medical device industries worldwide to research, develop, discover and
produce innovative healthcare products quickly and effectively.
[Biology]
Biology
WuXi Biology provides a full spectrum of services and solutions to support stand-alone and
integrated projects, from target discovery to candidate selection and into the clinic. Our
world-class discovery platform is backed by nearly 3000 scientists, offering expertise in all major
disease areas and target classes, across all therapeutic modalities. From small molecules, peptides,
oligonucleotides to biologics, our state-of-the-art services, quick study launches and fast
turnaround times meet the diverse needs of our clients.

[Small Molecule (CRDMO)]
Small Molecule (CRDMO)
We deliver small molecule solutions that are as powerful as they are personalized. From discovery to
market, our integrated CRDMO model simplifies your journey, providing the speed, quality and agility
your products and patients deserve—because we care, and we deliver.
[LEARN MORE ][17]
[Drug R&D Testing]
Drug R&D Testing
WuXi AppTec’s Laboratory Testing Division provides comprehensive, globally integrated CRDMO-enabling
solutions for pharmaceutical companies advancing small molecules, biologics, and emerging
therapeutic modalities. The division delivers end-to-end DMPK services, safety assessments, and
bioanalytical support throughout the development pipeline. With extensive experience in novel
compound classes including PROTACs, oligonucleotides, and ADCs, the team combines scientific
expertise, deep regulatory insight, and operational agility to accelerate drug development
timelines.

# CEO Message

[CEO Message]
[24e6f2a.jpg]

Dear Valued Customers, Collaborative Partners, Colleagues and Friends,

Over the course of more than two decades, every step taken at WuXi AppTec has been driven by one
commitment – to build comprehensive capability and technology enabling platform. One that can be
accessed by anyone and any company to lower the barriers of R&D and expedite the discovery and
development of new medicines for patients globally.

Starting from a single laboratory of 7,000 square feet in 2000, WuXi AppTec has grown into a global
CRDMO platform with more than 34,000 employees including over 31,000 scientists and technicians. We
take great pride in serving collaborative customers whose mission is to bring better medicines to
patients. For us, this is immensely rewarding.

Today, our industry is entering an unprecedented golden era of innovation, where the future of R&D
will be defined by a profoundly different model. A model where more and more scientists,
technologists, entrepreneurs, doctors, and patients will work together and participate in healthcare
innovation, thanks to a connected new healthcare ecosystem centered on patient needs.

The collective power of one – one individual, one organization, one idea, or just one dream – is
what the future of medicine can, and will be built upon.

At WuXi AppTec, we will continue to relentlessly enhance our enabling platform with comprehensive
capabilities and technologies by working together and enabling others. Our goal is to build the
foundations upon which anyone, and any company, can be empowered to realize their innovation dreams.
Together, we can continue to improve productivity, and bring new medicines to patients much faster.
WuXi AppTec's vision is that one day, every drug can be made, and every disease can be treated.

Underpinning this goal are our core values: "integrity and dedication, working together and sharing
success; doing the right thing and doing it right". They remain the cornerstone of everything we do
at WuXi AppTec.

Maximizing our collective potential to empower transformation, we believe, is the right thing to do.

Together, we will make a meaningful difference for patients.

Ge Li, Ph.D.
Chairman and CEO of WuXi AppTec

# Frequently Asked Questions About WuXi AppTec

## Company Overview & Business Model

### Q1: What is WuXi AppTec?

**A:** WuXi AppTec is a global contract research, development, and manufacturing organization
(CRDMO) serving the pharmaceutical and life sciences industries. Founded in 2000, WuXi AppTec works
with companies of all sizes around the world — from emerging biotech startups to leading
multinational pharmaceutical firms — across more than 30 countries to help bring life-saving or
life-improving medicines and therapies to patients.

### Q2: What is WuXi AppTec's CRDMO Model?

**A:** WuXi AppTec's [CRDMO model][16] integrates contract research, development and manufacturing
into a single platform, enabling innovators to move faster, lower costs, and improve the likelihood
of success. Across our three business segments – [WuXi Chemistry][17], [WuXi Biology][18], and [WuXi
Testing][19] – this integrated model streamlines the end-to-end drug development journey, eliminates
handoffs and reduces delays, while ensuring unwavering quality.

### **Q3:** What benefits does the CRDMO model bring to drug innovators?

A: For biotechs, our [CRDMO model][20] enables faster pipeline advancement and greater equity value
creation. For large pharma, it streamlines R&D to replenish pipelines more efficiently. For
patients, it translates to faster access, more affordable treatments, and greater hope.

### Q4: What services does WuXi AppTec provide?

**A:** WuXi AppTec provides integrated drug discovery, development and manufacturing services across
three business segments: WuXi Chemistry, WuXi Biology, and WuXi Testing.
* [WuXi Chemistry][21]: CRDMO services from drug discovery to commercial manufacturing, covering all
synthetic molecular modalities – small molecules, oligonucleotides, peptides and complex
conjugates.
* [WuXi Biology][22]: Biology services and solutions supporting standalone and integrated projects,
from target discovery to candidate selection and clinical entry.
* [WuXi Testing][23]: Integrated testing services across the full drug discovery and development
lifecycle.

### Q5: Where is WuXi AppTec located?

**A: **WuXi AppTec is a global company with operations across Asia, Europe, and North America,
including China, Singapore, Japan, South Korea, Germany, Switzerland, and the United States.

### Q6：What role does WuXi AppTec play in the pharmaceutical supply chain?

**A:** WuXi AppTec is a trusted partner to global customers across more than 30 countries, and its
facilities across Asia, Europe and the U.S. enable customers to develop and deliver medicines and
therapies to patients worldwide. WuXi AppTec is one of many contract service organizations
supporting the global pharmaceutical and life sciences industries and has no exclusive service
agreements with its customers, allowing them to work with multiple suppliers and maintain supply
chain resilience.

## Data Security, Privacy & Regulatory Oversight

### Q7: How does WuXi AppTec maintain customer trust?

**A: **Intellectual property (IP) protection is at the heart of WuXi AppTec's business model, and is
a foundation of the trust WuXi AppTec has built with customers since its founding in 2000.

### Q8: What data privacy and intellectual property laws and guidelines govern WuXi AppTec's
### operations?

**A****：**WuXi AppTec strictly adheres to all applicable data and IP protection laws, regulations,
and industry standards in jurisdictions in which it operates. In the U.S., this includes guidelines
set by the U.S. Department of Health & Human Services, Federal Trade Commission, and Food & Drug
Administration. In addition, WuXi AppTec's customers conduct regular inspections on us: in 2025, we
completed 60 customer information security audits, with no critical findings.

### Q9: What measures does WuXi AppTec use to protect customer data and intellectual property?

**A****：**All project data is compartmentalized by customer and accessible only to authorized
personnel. All U.S.-based project information is stored exclusively in U.S.-based facilities and IT
systems, separated by robust firewalls from operations in other countries.

### Q10: How does the company ensure quality, regulatory compliance, and information security across
### its global operations?

**A:** WuXi AppTec consistently adheres to the highest global quality standards and strictly
maintains a robust quality audit program that covers all main operational sites and functions to
drive the continuous improvement of Quality Management System (QMS). In 2025, WuXi AppTec completed
741 quality audits and inspections conducted by global customers, regulatory authorities and
independent third parties, as well as 60 information security audits by global customers, all with
no critical findings. All of our main sites are ISO/IEC 27001 certified.

## Corporate Governance & Business Scope

### Q11: What is WuXi AppTec's ownership structure?

**A:** WuXi AppTec is a publicly traded commercial enterprise with a diverse global shareholder
base, including leading institutional investors from the United States, Europe, Asia, and the Middle
East. As a public company, we owe fiduciary duties to create value for shareholders through
transparent, market-driven operations.

### Q12: Who leads WuXi AppTec?

**A: **WuXi AppTec is managed by its board of directors and senior executive management team. They
comprise established scientists and business professionals with no military background or political
party affiliation.

### Q13: Is WuXi AppTec a Chinese Military Company?

**A: **No. WuXi AppTec is not a Chinese military company.
* WuXi AppTec does not meet the statutory criteria for designation as a “Chinese military company”
under the applicable US laws.
* WuXi AppTec is not owned or controlled by, or affiliated with, any PRC military or government
authority.
* WuXi AppTec does not provide services to the PRC military; and the company is not associated with
the PRC's defense industrial base or military-civil fusion programs.

### Q14: Does WuXi AppTec do gene sequencing?

**A:** No. WuXi AppTec does not do human gene sequencing. WuXi AppTec does not have a human genomics
business or collect or deal with human genomic data.

### Q15: Does WuXi AppTec have cell and gene therapy (CGT) business?

**A:** WuXi AppTec sold its cell and gene therapy businesses to Altaris in March 2025, and is no
longer involved in this area.

# **The History of WuXi AppTec**

## About WuXi AppTec

In the early 2000s, the pharmaceutical industry needed partners who could combine scientific rigor
with speed and global scale. WuXi AppTec was established to meet that need—serving as an enabler
within the pharmaceutical ecosystem, partnering with innovators to lower R&D costs, and accelerating
the path from discovery to patients.

## Founding

WuXi AppTec was established in 2000 by four co-founders and a 7,000 square-foot laboratory with the
belief that every drug can be made, and every disease can be treated.

[The first lab at WuXi AppTec.jpg]

The first lab at WuXi AppTec

[The first fume hood at WuXi AppTec.jpg]

The first fume hood at WuXi AppTec

## Upholding the Highest Global Standards

For 25 years, WuXi AppTec has remained committed to helping customers advance life science discovery
and deliver treatments to those in need.

WuXi AppTec's service platform was built to meet the stringent requirements of both customers and
regulatory authorities. WuXi AppTec has received regulatory approvals from agencies in the U.S., EU,
Australia, Canada, China, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland and Saudi Arabia. The company maintains
the highest standards for intellectual property protection, data security, and privacy, and operates
in compliance with applicable laws and regulations across all jurisdictions in which it operates.

## Service Expansion in Early Years

Starting with laboratory chemical synthesis, WuXi AppTec progressively expanded its services to
biology and testing, and from the early stage of drug discovery all the way to commercialization and
manufacturing.
* In 2001, WuXi AppTec launched synthetic chemistry services.
* In 2003, WuXi AppTec launched process development services.
* In 2004, WuXi AppTec initiated manufacturing services for research and development.
* In 2005, WuXi AppTec began bioanalytical services.
* In 2007, WuXi AppTec introduced toxicology and formulation services, with additional campuses
launched.

## Global Growth

WuXi AppTec's global network of sites across Asia, Europe, and the U.S. allows the company to
support customers across therapeutic areas and time zones, providing continuity and flexibility
throughout the drug development process.
* In 2008, the company acquired the U.S.-based company AppTec, after which the company was renamed
WuXi AppTec, evolving into a more comprehensive platform for global innovators.
* In 2016, WuXi AppTec acquired Crelux, a German drug discovery service provider, enhancing its
structure-based drug discovery capabilities.
* In 2021, WuXi AppTec expanded into Couvet, Switzerland, bolstering its capabilities for
large-scale drug product production.
* In 2021, WuXi AppTec announced a new campus in Middletown, Delaware. Currently under construction,
the facility will provide U.S. biotech and pharmaceutical companies with local access to
formulation development and manufacturing services from preclinical to commercial stages.
* In 2024, WuXi AppTec broke ground on a new site in Singapore, expanding its API manufacturing
capabilities and strengthening its global network.

## [Integrated Contract, Research, Development, Manufacturing Organization (CRDMO) Platform][16]

Today, WuXi AppTec supports customers across the full spectrum of drug R&D and manufacturing.

Through its fully integrated [CRDMO model][17]—spanning every stage of drug development, a wide
range of modalities, and a global footprint that stretches across Asia, Europe, and the U.S.—the
company enables seamless transitions and accelerates the path from idea to medicine.

## Role in the Global Healthcare Community

[Event组图.png]

Active Contributor to Our Global Communities

Being part of the global healthcare community, WuXi AppTec's role goes beyond service delivery – the
company is humbled to support and sustain innovation ecosystems by linking startups, investors, and
industry.

Through leading conferences and professional events, WuXi AppTec unites thousands of global leaders
and entrepreneurs each year, strengthening collaboration across borders and across disciplines to
help make innovation accessible to all.

## WuXi AppTec Today

WuXi AppTec is proud of how far it has come. But it is even more excited about what lies ahead.

As science accelerates and technologies converge, the company stands ready—with its global platform,
its passionate people, and its enduring values—to help shape the future of healthcare.

As drug development becomes more complex and globally distributed, WuXi AppTec's integrated CRDMO
platform — spanning discovery, development, and manufacturing across Asia, Europe, and the U.S. — is
designed to help partners move faster so treatments can reach patients sooner.

# Business Conduct and Ethics

[Business Conduct and Ethics]

## Our Business Conduct and Ethics

Since its founding in 2000, WuXi AppTec has helped advance discoveries and innovation in the global
healthcare industry, with a vision that every drug can be made and every disease can be treated.
Through access to our capabilities and technology, customers are able to advance drug R&D and
manufacturing that have life-saving and groundbreaking impacts globally. As we conduct our business,
we have sought to gain the full trust of our customers and to grow alongside them in support of
their mission; to adhere to the highest standards of business ethics in all locations in which we
operate; and to build a strong security infrastructure and robust corporate culture that protects
and preserves the intellectual property and data of our customers. We are implementing green
manufacturing and sustainable operations across our business units, helping to improve the
environment and the communities in which we operate. We are committed to and maintain an inclusive
and vibrant workplace that fosters collaboration among and professional development for all WuXi
AppTec employees.

[Compliance with Local Regulatory Requirements]
Compliance with Local Regulatory Requirements
We strictly adhere to local laws and regulations in the regions in which we operate, and regularly
take into account economic, social and environmental factors in our decision-making and operations.
Data Security and Privacy
[Data Security and Privacy]
A core tenet of our business is to preserve the trust, confidence and privacy of our customers. Data
privacy and security is our highest priority. Since our founding, WuXi AppTec has maintained a
strong track record based on a rigorous and multi-layered internal process – everything we discover,
develop and deliver to our customers is secure, separated and protected. WuXi AppTec ensures that
all personal identifiable information (PII) is anonymized and protected. Further, we maintain a
robust system of corporate governance to ensure customers' information is protected and used in
accordance with the guidelines laid out by our customers and global privacy and healthcare policies.
Intellectual Property Protection
[Intellectual Property Protection]
Integral to the continued success and competitiveness of our customers – and therefore a lifeline of
our business – is their unique intellectual property (IP). Our approach to IP protection is embedded
in our founding principles of integrity, unwavering commitment to global quality standards and
world-class security. Our standards include a comprehensive IP management and infringement
accountability system. We are dedicated to adhering to industry best practices in all of our
facilities worldwide.
Global Standards
[Global Standards]
WuXi AppTec adheres to global quality and regulatory standards across all business operations –
including raw material procurement, R&D and processing, production and product quality management.
WuXi AppTec frequently conducts internal quality audits and has received regulatory approvals from –
and are routinely audited by – agencies in Australia, Canada, China, the European Union, New
Zealand, Switzerland, Saudi Arabia and the United States. We provide industry-leading products and
services to partners all over the world and are proud of our strong reputation for conducting high
quality work and for earning the continued trust of our customers.
Business Ethics and Anti-corruption
[Business Ethics and Anti-corruption]
WuXi AppTec has zero-tolerance for any form of corruption. Since our founding, we have maintained a
steadfast commitment to the integrity of our work, and we strictly adhere to local laws and
regulations and the highest standards of business ethics across the regions in which we operate.
WuXi AppTec demands adherence to these standards by each of our employees. To report a non-compliant
issue, please contact InternalAudit@wuxiapptec.com
Research and Development Ethics
[Research and Development Ethics]
WuXi AppTec consistently adheres to bioethical standards across all research projects. We support
innovative advances in research and technology that allow for groundbreaking and life-enhancing
discoveries, and expect our customers' research to abide by ethical norms and guidelines established
by policymakers, regulators and industry associations.
Environment, Health and Safety (EHS)
[Environment, Health and Safety (EHS)]
WuXi AppTec seeks to reduce the environmental impact of our operations by improving how we conduct
our operations. Our goals are to reduce the environmental impact of our supply chains, prevent
pollution and use our resources efficiently. We seek to promote the well-being of the environment
and our global society across all business operations. WuXi AppTec is committed to production
safety. All WuXi AppTec facilities meet stringent safety standards and strictly abide by the
relevant laws and regulations of their local jurisdiction. To supplement these standards, we have
established corresponding risk prevention and management systems.
Employee Welfare
[Employee Welfare]
The intellect, experience and dedication of our employees is WuXi AppTec's most valuable asset. They
are the driving force that enables WuXi AppTec to build an open-access platform, providing
comprehensive capabilities and technologies to the healthcare industry. WuXi AppTec is an equal
opportunity employer. We are proud of our diverse workforce, recruited from across the global health
sciences community. WuXi AppTec strives to foster an inclusive and collaborative workplace, with
robust on-the-job training and a commitment to professional development. WuXi AppTec is committed to
protecting the occupational health and safety of all employees and promoting a healthy work-life
balance.

# Sustainability

**Our Governance**

WuXi AppTec has established a business ethics management structure comprised of the Board of
Directors and the Audit Committee, the Executive Committee, the Internal Audit Department and a
compliance management task force from each business and operation unit. This framework is
responsible for formulating business-ethics management strategies, continuously maintaining and
improving the Company's business ethics management system and ensuring that the Company's operations
and decision-making comply with ethics standards and regulatory requirements. Each business and
operation unit takes the initiative to conduct business ethics risk management, promptly
identifying, assessing, controlling, and mitigating potential risks. This provides information for
the formulation and enhancement of the Company's overall business ethics management strategy and
promotes a corporate culture of ethics and compliance.

**Our Approach**

In accordance with the Code of Business Conduct and a comprehensive business ethics and compliance
framework, we employ a range of management practices aimed at proactively addressing business
ethical and compliance risks. We maintain high standards of business integrity through ongoing
training and communication, conducting effective ethical and compliance risk assessments and audits,
and upholding a transparent reporting system.

**Our Commitments and Goals**

• Comply with all applicable laws and regulations and uphold the high standards of business
ethics and compliance.
• Provide annual training on Code of Business Conduct and anti-corruption and bribery for all
active employees, maintaining a completion rate of over 95%.
• Achieve ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management Systems certification at 100% of main
sites by 2030.

**Our Key Initiatives**

• Become a participant in the United Nations Global Compact, supporting its ten principles.
• Regularly review and update our Code of Business Conduct to ensure its effectiveness in its
implementation.
• Incorporate business ethics indicators into employee performance and remuneration reviews.
• Conduct annual compliance training and exams for all employees (including part-time employees).
• Conduct regular audits of business ethics across all business lines, as well as supplier
audits, external audits, and internal audits. Develop and implement improvement plans based on audit
results.
• Adhere to the "3P Principles" (Prevention, Protection, Prosecution) to continuously improve the
information security management system, and effectively safeguard cybersecurity, privacy protection,
and intellectual property protection through multiple initiatives.

## About us

### Enabling Innovation

WuXi AppTec is a trusted partner and contributor to the pharmaceutical and life sciences industries,
providing R&D and manufacturing services that help advance healthcare innovation. With operations
across Asia, Europe, and North America, we offer integrated, end-to-end services through our unique
CRDMO (Contract Research, Development, and Manufacturing Organization) platform. We are privileged
to work alongside partners across 30+ countries, supporting their efforts to bring breakthrough
treatments to patients. Guided by our vision that every drug can be made and every disease can be
treated, we are committed to advancing breakthroughs for patients—one collaboration at a time.

## About us

### Enabling Innovation

WuXi AppTec is a trusted partner and contributor to the pharmaceutical and life sciences industries,
providing R&D and manufacturing services that help advance healthcare innovation. With operations
across Asia, Europe, and North America, we offer integrated, end-to-end services through our unique
CRDMO (Contract Research, Development, and Manufacturing Organization) platform. We are privileged
to work alongside partners across 30+ countries, supporting their efforts to bring breakthrough
treatments to patients. Guided by our vision that every drug can be made and every disease can be
treated, we are committed to advancing breakthroughs for patients—one collaboration at a time.

## About Us

# Our Leadership

[Our Leadership]
[Ge Li, Ph.D.]
Ge Li, Ph.D.
Chairman and CEO
Scientist and entrepreneur leading WuXi AppTec since its founding in 2000. Dr. Li pioneered an
integrated, open-access R&D enabling platform model to support innovators around the world to
discover, develop and commercialize new medicines and healthcare products for patients. Under Dr.
Li’s direction, WuXi AppTec has grown into a leading global company, providing comprehensive
research, development and manufacturing services in small molecule drugs, and emerging new
modalities. Through its unique CRDMO business models, WuXi AppTec is enabling innovative partners
globally. Dr. Li earned his doctoral degree in organic chemistry from Columbia University.
[Minzhang Chen, Ph.D.]
Minzhang Chen, Ph.D.
Co-CEO
Over 20 years of experience in pharmaceutical development and manufacturing. Played important roles
in R&D and commercialization of multiple innovative drugs for global launches. Awarded by The
Medicine Maker's 2019 & 2020 Power List as one of the global top inspirational medicine makers
driving the industry forward. Formerly Director of Technical Operations at Vertex. Bachelor's degree
in Chemistry from Peking University and Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry from the University of Minnesota.
[Steve Yang, Ph.D.]
Steve Yang, Ph.D.
Co-CEO
A pharmaceutical industry leader recognized for building R&D and service capabilities, delivering
research and early development portfolios of drug candidates, and establishing R&D partnerships in
US, Europe, China and other Asian and emerging markets. Before joining WuXi AppTec, Dr. Yang was
Vice President and Head of Asia and Emerging Markets iMed at AstraZeneca, and served as Vice
President and Head of Asia R&D at Pfizer and as Executive Director and head of Pfizer's global R&D
strategic management group. Dr. Yang received his Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Chemistry from the
University of California, San Francisco.
[Zhaohui Zhang ]
Zhaohui Zhang
Executive Vice President, China Chief Operating Officer
One of our co-founders, entrepreneur, formerly Senior Vice President of WuXi AppTec, Vice President
of Domestic Marketing of WuXi AppTec. EMBA from China Europe International Business School.
[Richard Connell, Ph.D.]
Richard Connell, Ph.D.
US/EU President
Over 35 years of experience in the biotech and drug discovery sector, before joining WuXi AppTec
Rick was Vice President of External Research Solutions at Pfizer. Managed a global network of
Contract Research Organizations, Contract Manufacturing Organizations, Biotech, technology and
academic partnerships. Held multiple management positions in the U.S., UK, Germany and China while
at Pfizer and Bayer. Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry from University of Notre Dame.
[Xiaoyong Fu, Ph.D.]
Xiaoyong Fu, Ph.D.
Executive Vice President, STA
Over 30 years of experience in Organic Chemistry, small molecule API process R&D and Manufacturing,
Process technology transfer as well as overall CMC. Formerly Sr. Fellow of Process Chemistry at
Schering-Plough/MSD. Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry from University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee.
[Florence Shi ]
Florence Shi
Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer
Over 20 years of rich professional knowledge and management experience in the fields of finance,
business development and operations. Most recently worked at General Electric as the Managing
Director of Business Development and CFO of GE China. Bachelor degree in International Finance from
Shanghai University.
[Howard Wu, J.D.]
Howard Wu, J.D.
Senior Vice President, Legal Department, Human Resources Department
Over 20 years of rich experience in the fields of legal, compliance management and cross region
management in the related areas. Before joining WuXi AppTec, Dr. Wu was General Manager of Legal
Department for the China region at Sinar Mas Group – Asia Pulp & Paper, and served as Chief
Compliance Counsel for GE Healthcare Greater China region, General Counsel for Momentive Performance
Material Asia Pacific region and a practicing lawyer in the US. Dr. Wu received Juris Doctor degree
from School of Law of University of the District of Columbia.
[Xuanjia Peng, Ph.D.]
Xuanjia Peng, Ph.D.
Senior Vice President, WuXi Testing, WuXi Biology, Automation Department
Since joining WuXi AppTec, Dr. Xuanjia Peng has successful track records in leading business and
operation units spanning drug discovery hit generation, chemistry catalog, chemistry service
operation, and medicinal chemistry service. Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry from Lanzhou University.
[Yu Lu ]
Yu Lu
Senior Vice President, WuXi TIDES, WuXi Chemistry Business Operations
Over 20 years of industry experience with a proven track record in pharmaceutical CMC development,
business development and marketing, new business creation as well as operations management.
Previously worked at Merck and Vertex.Master’s degree in chemistry from Duke University and MBA
degree from Kellogg School of Management, Northwestern University.
[Jinling Chen, Ph.D.]
Jinling Chen, Ph.D.
Senior Vice President, Pharmaceutical Development and Manufacturing
Over 20 years of experience in formulation & process development planning and strategy, drug
delivery technologies, formulation, drug product process development and manufacturing, CMC
regulatory submission. Holds more than 20 globally recognized patents. Formerly worked at Zeneca,
BSM, Lexicon. Ph.D. in Physical Chemistry from Monash University in Australia.
[Ke Chen, Ph.D.]
Ke Chen, Ph.D.
Senior Vice President, API Late Phase Development and Commercialization
Over 10 years of industry experience with proven track record in Organic Chemistry, small molecule
API process R&D and Manufacturing, process technology transfer as well as pharmaceutical CMC
development. Formerly Principal Scientist of Process Chemistry at Bristol-Myers Squibb. Ph.D. in
Organic Chemistry from University of Rochester.
[Tao Guo, Ph.D.]
Tao Guo, Ph.D.
Senior Vice President, RCS IPM
Over 20 years of experience in drug discovery, recipient of over 40 US issued patents and inventor
of one FDA approved drug. Formerly Director of Chemistry at Pharmacopeia and Senior Research
Scientist at ARIAD Pharmaceuticals. Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry from Columbia University.
[Dirk Tormans , Ph.D.]
Dirk Tormans , Ph.D.
Senior Vice President, WuXi Chemistry Global QA
Over 20 years of experience in pharmaceutical quality management, CMC development and commercial
manufacturing, regulatory submissions & compliance for small as well as large molecules. Formerly
Sr. Director Quality at Johnson & Johnson. Master's degree in Chemical Engineering (microbiology and
process technology) from the University of Leuven, Belgium.
[Youchu Wang, Ph.D.]
Youchu Wang, Ph.D.
Senior Vice President, API Early Phase Development
Over 20 years of experience in synthetic organic chemistry and small molecule process development.
Formerly Sr. Scientist of Process Chemistry at Wyeth. Ph.D.in Organic Chemistry from Chinese Academy
of Science followed by Postdoctoral Research at Memorial University of Newfoundland, Canada.
[Xiang Wu, Ph.D.]
Xiang Wu, Ph.D.
Senior Vice President, RCS
Over 20 years of industry experience with proven track record in medicinal chemistry and synthetic
organic chemistry. Formerly worked at AMRI. Ph.D. in Medicinal Chemistry from National University of
Singapore.
[Feng Zhang ]
Feng Zhang
Senior Vice President, API Manufacturing
Over 20 years of experience in API manufacturing. Responsible for the build-up and operations of
global API Manufacturing. Bachelor's degree in pharmaceutical from Shanghai Medical University and
EMBA degree in Finance and Economics from Shanghai University.

all_classified.company_summary: Ablinc is a leading contract manufacturing organization specializing in biomanufacturing and viral vector production, dedicated to advancing vaccines and biotherapeutics. With expertise in GMP manufacturing and analytical testing, the company supports the development of innovative therapies, including oncolytic viruses, gene therapies, and recombinant protein vaccines, catering to the needs of the biopharmaceutical industry. Their facilities in Rockville, Maryland, and Strasbourg, France, enable them to deliver high-quality solutions for preclinical and clinical development.

# Why AntiInfectiveMeds?

AntiInfectiveMeds started in 2010 as a niche blog about antibiotics, antifungal and antiviral
medicines. For almost 15 years we focused on explaining complex medical topics in simple language
and built a loyal community of readers who trusted our content.

Today, in the era of AI, people can get answers to many medical questions in seconds. We see this as
a positive change, but we also know that algorithms are not a replacement for carefully selected
products and real accountability to customers.

That is why we have transformed our experience into a convenient online shop focused on high-quality
generic medicines. From the original blog we have kept only a small selection of the most useful
articles and combined them with a modern shopping experience, so you can both learn about a medicine
and order it in one place.
* Carefully selected high-quality generics from trusted suppliers
* Fast and reliable worldwide delivery
* Clear, easy-to-understand information about medicines
* Friendly support via email, phone, and online chat

We continue to move forward, improving our service, expanding our range, and staying true to the
main principle of the AntiInfectiveMeds project: to be honest, easy to understand, and genuinely
helpful for our users.

operations, ensuring that you achieve greater efficiency and cost savings.

# Account Management

Optimize your supply chain with tailored strategies, real-time insights, and dedicated support for
efficiency and cost savings.

[ Talk To An Expert ][77]

## Account Management Services at Argus Logistics

At Argus Logistics, our Account Management services streamline your logistics operations with
personalized support. Our dedicated account managers optimize your supply chain, reduce costs, and
enhance service levels through proactive solutions. By understanding your business needs, we develop
tailored strategies for route optimization, cost-effective carrier selection, and regulatory
compliance, ensuring efficiency and adaptability. With continuous monitoring and data-driven
insights, we help you stay ahead in a dynamic market while maximizing operational performance.

[ Contact Us ][78]
[Account Management]

## Continuous Improvement for Lasting Success

At Argus Logistics, we don’t just manage your current logistics needs—we are dedicated to fostering
ongoing enhancement across all aspects of your supply chain. Our philosophy of continuous
improvement means we are constantly analyzing performance metrics, identifying areas for
optimization, and implementing innovative solutions to ensure your logistics operations remain
competitive and resilient.

Through regular performance reviews, we provide detailed insights into your logistics activities,
from freight spend and carrier performance to transit times and service levels. This allows us to
pinpoint inefficiencies and recommend targeted improvements that drive tangible results.

[choose argue account management]

## Why Choose Argus Logistics

By choosing Argus Logistics, you gain a trusted partner committed to your success. With deep
expertise in logistics management and a personalized approach, we ensure your operations are
streamlined, cost-effective, and prepared for the future. We understand the complexities of modern
logistics and provide innovative, tailored solutions that address your unique business needs.

Whether optimizing your supply chain, reducing costs, or improving service levels, we leverage
industry knowledge and cutting-edge technology to give you a competitive edge. Our end-to-end
services-from freight audit and payment to route optimization-ensure smooth operations. With a
proven track record and commitment to excellence, we help your business stay agile and responsive to
market changes. Let Argus Logistics be your partner in driving efficiency and cost savings.

## Key Features of Our Account Management Services

[solution]

### Tailored Solutions

We develop personalized strategies that align with your business goals, addressing unique challenges
and opportunities.

[real-time]

### Real-Time Visibility

Our advanced systems provide you with real-time updates on shipments, invoices, and overall
logistics performance, ensuring full transparency and control.

[time-is-money]

### Proactive Problem-Solving

By anticipating potential issues, we implement solutions before problems arise, minimizing
disruptions and enhancing operational stability.

[competitive-advantage]

### Competitive Advantage

Our services optimize logistics, improve cost transparency, and build strong carrier relationships,
giving you a competitive edge.

# Claims & Compliance

Ensure your business stays compliant and your claims are handled efficiently with Argus Logistics.
[ Talk To An Expert ][77]

## Claims & Compliance at Argus Logistics

At Argus Logistics, we understand the importance of effective claims management and compliance in
ensuring smooth logistics operations. Our services help navigate the complexities of regulatory
requirements, minimizing risks, delays, and disruptions. We proactively manage claims and ensure
adherence to industry standards, avoiding costly penalties. With our expert team providing
end-to-end support, we help prevent compliance issues and efficiently handle claims, ensuring your
logistics operations remain secure, compliant, and optimized for success.
[ Contact Us ][78]
[Claims & Compliance]

## Ensuring Compliance with Industry Regulations

Compliance is a top priority in the logistics industry, and we help ensure that your business
adheres to all relevant regulatory standards. Our Claims & Compliance services ensure that your
operations are aligned with both local and global regulations, including transportation safety
standards, environmental policies, and international trade requirements. We stay up-to-date with
evolving laws and industry trends, providing you with the necessary tools to stay compliant and
avoid potential legal issues.

Our compliance-focused solutions ensure that your shipments, documentation, and processes are always
in line with legal requirements. This reduces the risk of penalties and enhances your credibility
with clients and regulatory bodies.

[Industry Regulations]

## Our Claims & Compliance Approach

We take a comprehensive and proactive approach to managing claims and ensuring compliance across
your supply chain. By gaining a deep understanding of the regulatory landscape, we combine this
expertise with cutting-edge technology to streamline the claims process. Centralizing all
claim-related data provides full visibility and control, making it easier to resolve disputes and
manage compliance documentation.

Our focus is on both prevention and resolution. Through continuous monitoring of logistics
operations, we identify potential issues early to prevent them from escalating. Our expert team
ensures your business adheres to necessary regulations, helping avoid unnecessary fines and
disruptions. By taking a proactive stance, we help you stay ahead of challenges, ensuring smooth and
efficient operations.

## Why Choose Argus Logistics for Claims & Compliance?

[Expert Compliance Management]

### Expert Compliance Management

Our team ensures that your operations consistently meet industry regulations, minimizing risks and
avoiding penalties through proactive compliance management.

[claim]

### Efficient Claims Resolution

We streamline the claims process with automated systems, reducing delays and administrative costs,
while ensuring faster, more accurate resolutions to prevent disruptions.

[Tailored, Data-Driven Solutions]

### Tailored, Data-Driven Solutions

We provide customized claims and compliance solutions backed by advanced analytics, helping you make
informed decisions and continuously improve operational efficiency.

[competitive-advantage]

### Competitive Advantage

Our services optimize logistics, improve cost transparency, and build strong carrier relationships,
giving you a competitive edge, while ensuring timely deliveries and operational efficiency.

# Data Analytics

Harness advanced analytics for real-time insights, optimized supply chain performance, and smarter,

[ Talk To An Expert ][77]

## Data Analytics for Logistics Excellence

At Argus Logistics, we transform raw data into strategic insights, empowering you to make smarter,
data-driven decisions. Our advanced analytics solutions help optimize supply chain performance,
reduce inefficiencies, and enhance cost transparency. With real-time tracking, predictive modeling,
and customized reporting, we enable you to anticipate demand fluctuations, streamline operations,
and improve carrier performance. By leveraging powerful data analytics, we help you stay agile,
competitive, and prepared for future challenges in an ever-evolving logistics landscape.

[ Contact Us ][78]
[Data Analytics logistics]

## What We Offer

We provide comprehensive Data Analytics solutions designed to optimize your supply chain operations.
Our services include seamless data integration across multiple platforms, consolidating logistics
data from shipping, inventory, and vendor systems into a unified view. This enables you to make
informed decisions based on real-time insights. Our real-time tracking tools help monitor shipments
and address inefficiencies as they arise, while custom reporting and visualizations offer clarity on
key performance indicators and trends. We also leverage predictive analytics to forecast demand,
optimize delivery routes, and anticipate disruptions, ensuring smooth operations. Additionally, our
cost optimization insights help identify opportunities to reduce expenses and enhance efficiency,
boosting profitability across your logistics network.
[Logistics Operations Today]

## Start Transforming Your Logistics Operations Today

At Argus Logistics, we believe that data is the key to unlocking efficiency and driving business
growth. Our advanced Data Analytics solutions provide real-time insights into every aspect of your
supply chain, allowing you to identify trends, mitigate risks, and enhance decision-making. From
predictive modeling to performance tracking, our tools empower businesses to optimize processes,
reduce costs, and improve overall logistics efficiency.

With AI-driven analytics, we help you anticipate demand fluctuations, prevent disruptions, and
streamline operations for maximum productivity. Our tailored reporting and visualization tools
provide a clear, actionable view of your logistics performance, ensuring you have the right data at
the right time to make informed decisions.

## Benefits of Our Data Analytics Services

Empower your team with insights that support strategic planning and daily operations. Data-driven
decisions lead to better outcomes, helping your business maintain a competitive edge.

[efficiency]

Streamline processes and reduce waste with data-driven operational improvements. Our analytics tools
help you find inefficiencies and eliminate bottlenecks, improving overall performance.

[Improved Customer Satisfaction]

### Improved Customer Satisfaction

Deliver on-time and accurately by using predictive tools to stay ahead of challenges. Happy
customers mean stronger relationships and better business outcomes.

[solutions]

Whether you're managing a small supply chain or a global logistics network, our analytics solutions
grow with your needs. As your business expands, our tools adapt to handle increased complexity
without compromising performance.

# Operational Excellence

Argus Logistics drives operational excellence by optimizing supply chains, reducing costs, and
enhancing efficiency with data-driven solutions.

[ Talk To An Expert ][77]

## Achieving Operational Excellence in Logistics

The logistics landscape is evolving, driven by digital transformation, globalization, and rising
customer demands. At Argus Logistics, we believe Operational Excellence is essential for staying
competitive. By optimizing every aspect of your logistics operations—from freight bill auditing to
route optimization—we help streamline processes, reduce costs, and improve service delivery. Through
advanced technology and industry expertise, we ensure your logistics operations are efficient,
adaptable, and future-ready, offering enhanced cost management, improved efficiency, and a more
resilient supply chain.
[ Contact Us ][78]
[Operational Excellence in Logistics]

## Beyond Continuous Improvement

Logistics companies striving for true Operational Excellence need to go beyond simply optimizing
warehouse processes. It begins with a deep understanding of what is essential throughout the entire
operation. Success comes from viewing all aspects of the business—people, technology, resources, and
the environment—holistically. Rather than treating these elements separately, the focus is on
improving processes, services, and resources across the entire logistics chain.

Operational Excellence isn’t just about incremental improvements; it’s about achieving sustainable
excellence across the entire value chain. By leveraging advanced technologies, data-driven insights,
and strategic process optimization, businesses can streamline operations, improve service quality,
and reduce costs while staying adaptable to future market trends. This comprehensive approach
ensures long-term success and a competitive edge in an ever-evolving logistics landscape.

[Sustainable Long-Term Growth]

## Sustainable Long-Term Growth

At Argus Logistics, Operational Excellence is not just about improving performance; it’s about
creating lasting value for both customers and stakeholders. To achieve sustainable long-term growth,
businesses must focus on identifying areas where value can be added while also recognizing and
eliminating waste. By analyzing each part of the logistics operation—from resource allocation to
workflow processes—we help organizations establish the most efficient flow that ensures both
effectiveness and sustainability. Our comprehensive approach emphasizes improving the entire
logistics ecosystem, including optimizing transportation, inventory management, and supplier
relationships.

Our systematic approach to problem-solving ensures that even when challenges arise, there is a clear
path to realigning operations and getting back on course. Through continuous optimization, our
solutions enable businesses to enhance operational efficiency, reduce waste, and ultimately achieve
enduring growth and success in the competitive logistics landscape. We focus on adapting to market
technological advancements and evolving customer needs.

## Top 4 Benefits of Operational Excellence

[save-money]

### Cost Savings

By identifying inefficiencies and eliminating waste, businesses can significantly reduce operational
costs. Operational Excellence helps optimize resource usage, ensuring better cost management and
higher profitability.

[optimization]

### Increased Efficiency

Operational Excellence focuses on streamlining processes, eliminating bottlenecks, and improving
workflows. This leads to higher productivity, faster operations, and reduced downtime, ultimately
maximizing output.

[expert team]

### Better Customer Satisfaction

Operational Excellence leads to better service delivery, ensuring products and services are
delivered on time and at high quality. This enhances customer experiences, leading to higher loyalty
and repeat business.

[competitive-advantage]

### Greater Agility

Companies that focus on Operational Excellence are more adaptable and responsive to changing market
conditions. By continuously optimizing processes, businesses can quickly adjust to customer demands,
technological advancements, and industry trends.

# Procurement & Route Engineering

Optimize procurement and routes with Argus Logistics for cost savings, faster deliveries, and
improved efficiency.
[ Talk To An Expert ][77]

## Procurement & Route Engineering: Optimizing Your Supply Chain

At Argus Logistics, we provide innovative procurement and route engineering solutions to streamline
your supply chain. By optimizing sourcing and leveraging advanced routing techniques, we ensure
cost-effective operations, faster deliveries, and improved efficiency. Our tailored strategies help
enhance procurement and transportation performance, keeping you ahead in the competitive logistics
landscape.

[ Contact Us ][78]
[Procurement Engineering]

## Driving Efficiency Through Strategic Sourcing & Route Optimization

In today’s fast-paced logistics environment, efficiency is key to maintaining a competitive edge. At
Argus Logistics, we take a strategic approach to sourcing and route engineering to optimize both
procurement and transportation processes. Our team works closely with you to identify cost-saving
opportunities, secure reliable suppliers, and ensure the timely availability of goods.

With our route engineering expertise, we utilize advanced technology to design optimal delivery
routes that consider factors such as traffic, distance, and delivery schedules. This not only
minimizes fuel costs but also reduces carbon footprints, making your logistics operations more
sustainable. Whether it’s improving supplier relationships or fine-tuning delivery paths, our
comprehensive solutions help your business reduce operational costs and boost performance across the
entire supply chain.

[Routing Solutions]

## Efficient Procurement & Routing Solutions

At Argus Logistics, we provide integrated solutions that combine strategic procurement and precise
route engineering to create a seamless, efficient supply chain. Our expert team focuses on reducing
procurement costs while ensuring the quality and timely delivery of products, allowing you to focus
on growing your business. We help you navigate sourcing challenges, manage supplier relationships,
and optimize inventory levels for smooth and cost-effective operations.

Our route engineering capabilities leverage the latest technology and data analytics to optimize
your transportation network. By designing routes that reduce fuel consumption, avoid delays, and
improve delivery efficiency, we ensure your shipments are cost-effective and reliable. With a
data-driven approach, we continuously refine logistics strategies to adapt to changing market
conditions and operational demands.

business needs, ensuring efficiency and cost savings.

Our approach helps reduce procurement costs and optimize transportation routes, leading to

We focus on optimizing your supply chain to ensure on-time deliveries, dependable supplier

# About Us

Argus Logistics leverages 30+ years of expertise and cloud-based technology to streamline
operations, cut costs, and drive growth.

[ Talk To An Expert ][77]

## We Help You Ship Smarter

As a market leader in our industry, some might say we more closely resemble a tech company. We
provide you with everything you need to take your operation to the next level. Cloud based,
customizable technology with actionable business analytics will help you to focus on your customers
and give you a market advantage. Your bottom line will appreciate Argus Logistics as much as your
employees.

Argus brings over 30 years of experience in the industry. Business growth inevitably brings pain.
Our expertise will ensure best practices are implemented as we work collaboratively with your
employees. With Argus, you will see that is possible to simultaneously save money and streamline
operations.

[ Contact Us ][78]
[about us]

## Client Services

Large companies often benefit from services that smaller businesses may not be aware of or assume
are too expensive. These services, designed to optimize operations and reduce costs, include
customized logistics solutions, advanced technology integration, and negotiated shipping rates. For
instance, large corporations often have tailored supply chain management services that streamline
every part of their logistics, such as route optimization, inventory management, and real-time
tracking. Additionally, they leverage cutting-edge technologies like AI-driven analytics and machine
learning to predict demand and manage inventory effectively.

Through bulk shipping, they secure discounted freight rates, further improving their bottom line.
Many also have dedicated teams managing carrier relationships, claims, and procurement, ensuring
smooth operations and quick problem resolution. Furthermore, they often employ risk management
strategies, such as more robust insurance options and real-time shipment monitoring, to avoid costly
disruptions. With logistics providers like Argus Logistics, these services are becoming more
accessible to businesses of all sizes, helping smaller companies optimize their supply chains and
enjoy the same advantages as larger corporations.

[logistics]

## What is Full Platform Logistics Management?

Full Platform Logistics Management at Argus offers comprehensive strategies to optimize every aspect
of transportation, ensuring efficiency and cost savings at every stage. Our client management
process includes clear KPIs, milestone tracking, and monthly business reviews, with a focus on
quality control and operational excellence. We provide transparent procurement and route
engineering, using rapid E-RFQ technology and a network of vetted carriers. Our platform offers
single visibility, exception management, and 24/7 shipment tracking, while our freight bill audit
ensures accurate billing with less than 1% variance. We also manage claims, compliance, and
certifications, and offer advanced technology integration with ERP & WMS systems. With robust
business intelligence tools, real-time tracking, and safety monitoring, Argus Logistics guarantees
optimal performance across the supply chain.

## Why Choose Us

[Comprehensive Reporting]

### Business Intelligence & Reporting

Our fully customizable dashboard will help each member of your team focus on their individual
metrics. Comprehensive reporting combined with our ongoing expert analysis will help you with your
KPI tracking so you know exactly how much you spend on freight.

[Freight Bill Audit & Pay]

### Freight Bill Audit & Pay

At Argus Logistics, we use a comprehensive multi-step process to audit your freight bills. We ensure
pricing compliance, identify discrepancies, and provide actionable insights to help you save on
freight costs and improve payment accuracy.

[real-time-tracking]

### All Modes of Transportation

You don’t have to use one service provider for your LTL freight and another for your FTL and still
another for your ocean containers. From small package to chartered aircraft, from domestic to
international, any size of truck, train, or plane- we expertly manage it all.

[End-to-End Service]

### Minority Supplier | SSAE 18 Compliant

We are certified as a bona fide Minority Business Enterprise as defined by National Minority
Supplier Development Council, Inc. (NMSDC) and as adopted by the Michigan Minority Supplier
Development Council. We are also compliant on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE 18).

## Client Driven Approach

We mention customized programs and each client being unique a lot, because it is true and is a
cornerstone of our mutual success. For a successful partnership, it is imperative that our program
fits each client’s unique needs and that we are in sync with strategic corporate directives. To
drive customization there are several key factors.
[Client Driven Approach]
[core value]

## Core Values

Our core values are what drives our success with our client base. We are and will continue to be the
hardest working, experts in the logistics industry. Our reputation has what has allowed our business
to be successful from day one and that is a direct correlation to our employees, our corporate
culture and core values.

## Client Focused

With 100+ clients, in many different industries, located across the globe the culmination of our
collective experience is what drives our ability to be flexible, delivering best practice solutions
to our client base.
[Client Focused]

## Our Mission, Vision, and Values

[mission]

### Our Mission

To provide our clients with the team, processes, technology, and expertise through a comprehensive
world class logistics management platform to allow them to gain full control of their supply chain
and maximize savings. It is our mission to ensure every stakeholder, FROM THE SHIPPING DOCK TO THE
BOARDROOM, recognizes the value and efficiencies gained through the mutual success of a partnership
with Argus.

[Our Vision]

### Our Vision

To create a community of logistics stakeholders that executes all aspects of logistics at the most
opportune cost through an intuitive process that encompasses over 25 years of collective experience.
It is our vision to provide each stakeholder with the tools, data and resources to maximize their
value and potential within their own organization.

[values]

### Our Values

Honesty, transparency and sustainability. Our core values craft our relationships and corporate
culture allowing us to foster a reputation of the hardest-working logistics management team in the
industry. These values have led our sustainability as an organization with world class client
retention driven by our proven bottom line results.

and Mexico. With advanced technology, dedicated experts, and a strong network of trusted carriers,

costs. Whether managing domestic shipments or cross-border logistics, Argus ensures seamless,
reliable operations across North America, driving performance and long-term success with customized,
data-driven solutions.

all_classified.polished_summary: Arguslogistics is a non-asset based logistics management company that specializes in providing customized, comprehensive logistics solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of various industries, including automotive, health and beauty, and consumer electronics. Their core services encompass freight bill audit and pay, account management, operational excellence, data analytics, compliance management, and transportation management systems, all aimed at enhancing efficiency, reducing costs, and supporting businesses in achieving their logistics and sustainability goals.

all_classified.company_summary: Atea Pharma is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to addressing unmet medical needs through innovative antiviral treatments. The company specializes in developing oral antiviral therapies, including Bemnifosbuvir and Ruzasvir, both of which are designed to treat hepatitis C virus (HCV) with potent pan-genotypic activity. Atea Pharma primarily targets patients suffering from hepatitis C, aiming to provide effective solutions in the healthcare and pharmaceutical industries.

Committed to the discovery, development and commercialization of oral direct-acting antiviral therapies.

HCV

Regimen of bemnifosbuvir / ruzasvir

The regimen of bemnifosbuvir, a nucleotide analog polymerase inhibitor and ruzasvir, an NS5A inhibitor, is advancing in a global Phase 3 development program for the treatment of hepatitis C virus (HCV). In a global Phase 2 study, the regimen met its primary endpoints of efficacy and safety. As single agents, both bemnifosbuvir and ruzasvir have demonstrated potent pan-genotypic antiviral activity against HCV.

ABOUT BEMNIFOSBUVIR / RUZASVIR REGIMEN

ATEA PHARMACEUTICALS

Combining innovative discoveries with development expertise to advance antivirals with the potential to transform treatments for patients with serious viral diseases.

Atea is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company working to address unmet medical needs with innovative oral antiviral therapies.

Advancing Oral Antiviral Therapies with Multibillion Dollar Market Opportunities

Our science.

Leveraging our deep understanding of antiviral drug development, medicinal chemistry, biology, biochemistry and virology, we are discovering and developing novel product candidates to treat single stranded ribonucleic acid, or ssRNA, viruses, which are a prevalent cause of serious viral diseases. Currently, we are focused on the development of orally-available direct-acting antiviral agents for the treatment of hepatitis C virus (HCV).

#### ABOUT ATEA

# At our core, we are a passionate group of people….

Dedicated to advancing oral antiviral therapeutics for patients worldwide affected by viral
diseases.

## Driven to transform the treatment of serious viral infections.

Leveraging the power of our medicinal chemistry expertise and discovery capabilities, we are focused
on discovering, optimizing, and rapidly advancing novel drug candidates that have the potential to
meet unmet medical needs or improve the current standard of care. Our programs in hepatitis C and
hepatitis E demonstrate this focus.

## Scientific leaders in the fight against severe viral diseases.

Our medicinal chemistry and virology expertise, bolstered by our collective experience in drug
development, is enabling us to pioneer new advancements in antiviral science.

[A scientist looking through the binoculars of a stereomicroscope.]

## Atea’s Giving Culture

Atea and its employees believe in giving back to the community and work to achieve this goal on a
local and global level. We are proud to contribute to local programs that help children and families
in Massachusetts, provide sponsorship resources to conferences and academics in our field of
research and support organizations that provide medical and humanitarian aid.

## Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at Atea

At Atea, we believe that our long-term success and ability to deliver medicines to patients requires
a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce. We are committed to creating an environment where all
Atea employees are enabled to achieve their full potential. By providing the opportunity for
employees to bring their unique differences and perspectives to work, our business grows stronger
with original thinking.

We promote an environment of diversity, equity and inclusiveness at Atea, regardless of race,
gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, national origin, physical disability, or age.

Atea is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to addressing unmet medical needs
through novel antiviral treatments.
