### How do antiviral medications work?

][46] [

Antiviral medications have advanced the medical field and patient care significantly. And many of
these vaccines have made incurable diseases preventable. We don’t have to look too far in the past
to discover their importance. For instance, these anti-viral vaccines saved countless lives during
Covid-19 epidemic. Even HIV has become manageable through the use of vaccines. But to understand how
these vaccines work, we will have to know about viruses and how they operate spread in the body.
Understanding Viruses A virus is a germ that causes illness. However, viruses cannot survive on its
own. In order to grow and spread it needs a host. The healthy cells of the body act as a host.
Viruses are a source of many lethal and non-lethal diseases, like HIV/AIDS The flu and the common
cold Ebola Herpes Hepatitis B and Measles Chickenpox and shingles Covid-19 Viruses and bacteria have
different makeup and antiviral medications are targeted to destroy vuruses and not bacteria. For
dealing with bacterial infections, antibiotics are the drugs of choice. The breakthrough in treating
viruses came with vaccines which were invented later than antibiotics. Let us take the differences
if viruses and bacteria in greater detail. Feature Viruses Bacteria Nature Non-living outside host
(acellular particles) Living single-celled organisms (prokaryotes) Cell structure Have no defined
cell structure. The main structure is genetic material (DNA or RNA) inside a protein coat (capsid)
Complete cell with all elements of cell: cell wall, plasma membrane, cytoplasm, ribosomes, and
genetic material (DNA) Size They are miniscule (20–300 nm) Much larger in size (0.2–5 µm)
Reproduction They are like parasites and are not self-sustaining. Make copies only inside host cells
using host biology. Mutate independently by binary fission Genetic material Either DNA or RNA, but
not both at the same time. Always DNA (double-stranded, circular) Metabolism Possess no metabolism
as they are not self-sustaining. Have metabolic activity (respiration, enzyme production, nutrient
processing) Living/Non-living status Considered non-living outside host, living only when inside
host Living organisms Treatment Invulnerable to antibiotics. Although some variants
prevented/controlled with vaccines or antiviral drugs. Many treatable with antibiotics. Examples of
diseases Influenza, HIV/AIDS, COVID-19, measles Tuberculosis, cholera, strep throat, typhoid
Beneficial uses Used in gene therapy, vaccine development, bacteriophage therapy Used in food
production (yogurt, cheese), biotechnology, nitrogen fixation, gut microbiome health Antivirals: How
They Prevent the Spread of Viral Illnesses Viruses spread by replicating and creating copies of
themselves. Antiviral medications fight off the virus by blocking this replication process. Each
anti-viral is different and takes a different approach to curing a virus, but the basic process
always involves disrupting the replication process of a virus. Not every antiviral has an immediate
effect. Some only reduce the acuteness of symptoms and reduce the duration of the infection.
COVID-19 or flu antivirals work in this way and shorten the duration of virus. However, in chronic
viruses, even anti-virus medications are unable to completely destroy the virus. In these scenarios,
the antiviral medication reduce the severity of the virus by lowering the amount of virus in the
body. This helps in controlling the transmission of the virus. But the danger is always lurking, and
if the prescribed dosage is not taken regularly, the virus can quickly regenerate.   Antivirals can
also be used as preventive medicine to actually protect against viruses. Most of the antivirals are
oral medicines, but antivirals also come in vaccine form that can be injected. Antivirals can be
given to all ag groups, from adults to children and even pregnant women, but the dosage varies.
Anti-Viral Treatment Tamiflu® is for influenza, and Paxlovid® for COVID-19, are often indicated for
several days. At times, they may have to be used for a week or even more. These drugs work best when
given within 2 days after infection. After this time, their use may still be helpful, particularly
if complications may be anticipated. Risk Factors Before starting a course of antivirals, an
assessment needs to be done to know about risk factors of the patient. Some risk factors actually
increase the likelihood of complications. Some diseases that increase the risk are. Asthma Blood
disorders Diabetes Heart disease Kidney disorders Liver conditions Overall health factors also play
a part in increasing the chance of side effects from vaccines. Some common factors are Obesity
Reduced immunity caused by health conditions or prescriptions Pregnancy Age - People over 65 and
older and children under two are highly susceptible Chronic Ill

## Antibodies

India's best supplier | Polyclonal, Monoclonal, Primary and Secondary Antibodies. Clementia Biotech
offers more than 70,000 polyclonal antibodies, 6,500 Monoclonal Antibodies and 70 Secondary
Antibodies. Antibodies have applications [IHC][150], [WB][151], [ELISA Kit][152], IP, IF, FCM,
IF/ICC etc. The antibodies are affinity purified, available in pack sizes of 60ul, 100ul, 120ul,
200ul, 500ul, 1ml. The antibodies are offered from brands Abbexa Ltd, [Affinity Bioscience][153]s,
[St John's Laboratory Ltd,][154] [Arigo Biolaboratories][155], [Cloud-Clone Corp][156], [CusaBio
Technology LLC][157], [Elabscience Biotechnology Inc][158]., [ELK Biotechnology Co. Ltd.][159] and
[Wuhan Fine Biotech Co., Ltd][160].. The antibodies have research use in the area of [Autoimmunity,
Apoptosis, Bone metabolism, Breast Cancer, Cardiovascular, CD & Adhesion molecule, Circadian rhythm,
Cytokines, Dermatology, Developmental Biology, Endocrinology, Enzyme & Kinase, Gastroenterology,
Genetics, Hematology, Hepatology, Hormone Study, Immunodeficiency, Infection immunity, Kidney
biomarker, Liver cancer, Metabolic pathway, Neurosciences, Nutrition metabolism, Ophthalmology,
Oral Health, Otorhinolaryngology, Pulmonology, Reproductive science, Rheumatology, Signal
transduction and Tumor research.][161] . The products are meant for laboratory research use only.
The products are not for diagnostic or medicinal use for humans or animals. We supply directly or
through our dealers to Research Institutes, Universities & Collges for research studies. For product
data sheet or quotation please contact us at sales@clementiabiotech.com

## Western Blot (WB)

Western Blot is laboratory method to separate and analyzes any specific protein in the sample
containing mixture of different proteins. The method is used in Cell and Molecular Biology analysis
of proteins. The overview of the western blot method include
1) Processing of protein samples for analysis,
2) Separation of size specific proteins by electrophoreses,
3) Transfer of proteins bands on nitrocellulose membrane,
4) determining the proteins with the help of protein specific primary antibodies and secondary
antibodies.

The term blotting refers to transfer of biological samples from a gel of separation to a solid
platform such as nitrocellulose membrane and determination or identification of proteins. Western
Blotting is also known as protein blotting or immunoblotting. The method is based on the principle
of immunochromatography in which proteins are separated in polyacrylamide gel on the basis of their
size i.e molecular weight. The SDS-PAGE technique is best suitable for western blotting. The method
provides qualitative or semi quantitative results.

Clementia Biotech provides Primary Antibodies, Secondary Antibodies, Substrate, Polyvinylidene
difluoride (PVDF) or Nitrocellulose membrane, Electrophories reagents (acrylamide and
N,N'-methylene-bis-acrylamide (BIS)) , Buffers, Dyes, Stains, electrophoresis apparatus and others.

## RNA Isolation

RNA, a Ribonucleic acid is polymer of nucleotides. It plays crucial biological roles in coding,
decoding, regulation and expression of genetic information. The RNA macromolecule consists of
single-strand which is folded onto itself. RNA is mainly found in the cytoplasm of the cell even
though it is generally synthesized in the nucleus. RNA have both genetic and catalytic properties.

### Product Categories

* [Norgen's RNA Isolation Kits][161]
* [Reagents][162]

There are 4 main types of RNA developed from their own set of genes including (1) mRNA - Messenger
RNA, (2) tRNA - Transfer RNA, (3) rRNA - Ribosomal RNA & (4) snRNA - Small nuclear RNA. The four
RNA type functions differently as the mRNA encodes amino acid sequence of a polypeptide, the tRNA
brings amino acids to ribosomes during translation, the rRNA along with ribosomal proteins makes up
the ribosomes which translate the mRNA and snRNA (Small nuclear RNA) in combination with specific
protein forms complexes in eukaryotes to process RNA. In eukaryotic cell rRNA account for 80% of
the total RNA present in the cell.

To obtain good quality RNA challenges comes the way as the isolated RNA quality may be compromised
due to genomic DNA contamination, degradation of RNA during process or storage, inhibitors in the
RNA and low yields of RNA, few to name. RNA isolation procedure is critical as the ribonuclease
enzymes which exists in cells and tissues can rapidly degrade RNA. In such particular cases RNase
inhibitors inhibits and control for such contaminants. Some commercially available kits provide
RNAse inhibitor to maintain quality of RNA isolated.

Different methods can be applied to RNA isolation or purification from research samples this include
phenol-chloroform extraction method, spin column purification method, and the use of magnetic beads.
The major disadvantages of phenol extraction method is the possible contamination of the RNA
preparation with phenol. Spin column purification and magnetic beads methods have advantage over it
as the commercially available ready to use kits provides phenol free RNA in simple and fast way.

Our offered RNA Isolation kits / RNA Purification Kits are spin column based kits, delivering phenol
free, high quality total RNA irrespective of size or GC content. The kits are convenient to use &
fast to process multiple samples in short time. The kits are suitable to isolate RNA from cells,
blood, plasma/serum, saliva, CSF, Tissue, formalin-fixed, paraffin embedded (FFPE) tissue samples,
soil, fecal, and water samples. The RNA purified by kits is suitable for a variety of downstream
applications, including Small RNA Sequencing.

Please contact us at support@clementiabiotech.com to suggest and quote you RNA isolation kit for
your research needs.

## Biochemical Analysis

Clementia Biotech offered wide range of biochemical assay kits with applications in analysis and
determination of biomarkers, Amino acids, Ions, Peptides, Proteins and Enzymes. The assay kits are
useful as a research tools in the areas of Enzyme Activity, Oxidative Stress, Metabolism, Diabetes &
Obesity, Glycolysis & Carbohydrates, Blood Chemistry, Urine Chemistry, Lipids metabolism, Signal
Transduction, Inorganic ions (Cations & Anions), Enzyme inhibition screening, Food, Plants, Plant
Stress Resistance and, Environmental research.

The assay are based on principle of Colorimetry, Spectrophotometry, and Fluorimetry. The assays
requires microplate reader, spectrophotometer, flow-cytometeror fluorescence microplate reader to
measure the test readings. The kits are available in pack sizes of 48/50T or 96/100T. The assays are
suitable to wide range of lab research samples, convenient to use, reproducible, fast and easy to
store. Suitability of the kit for a particular sample can be checked from kit manuals. The kits
meant for animal research have suitability for animal Serum, plasma, tissue, saliva, urine and other
biological samples. Small sample need for analysis enables sample saving.

Some of the top selling assay kits with us include Nitric Oxide Assay Kit, Non-esterified Free Fatty
Acids (NEFA) Assay Kit, Catalase Activity Assay kit, Superoxide Dismutase (SOD) Assay Kit, Alkaline
Phosphatase Activity Assay Kit, COX Inhibitor Screening Assay Kit, TBARS TCA Method) Assay
Kit, Creatinine (serum) Assay Kit, Glycerol Assay Kit, Triglyceride Assay Kit, Total Antioxidant
Assay Kit, COX Activity Assay Kit, Glutathione S-Transferase Assay Kit, Glutathione Reductase Assay
Kit, Glutathione Peroxidase Assay Kit, Nitrate/Nitrite Colorimetric Assay Kit, Protein Carbonyl
Assay Kit and others.

We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing novel therapeutics to meet the growing
global need for effective, safe antiviral treatments.  We employ a unique structure-based drug
discovery technology platform and Nobel Prize-winning expertise to create viable antiviral drugs.
 Our antivirals target the replication process and are designed to be safe, broad-spectrum,
resistant and convenient to administer.

We are quickly and efficiently advancing multiple antiviral candidates with clinical programs for
norovirus, influenza and coronaviruses, while also discovering and developing antiviral compounds
for other high-value indications.

## Targeted Solutions for Viral Diseases

Novel antiviral therapeutics for the treatment of serious and/or chronic viral diseases including
influenza, COVID-19, hepatitis C and gastroenteritis caused by norovirus.

[View Product Pipeline][33]

### About Us

Cocrystal Pharma, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company discovering and developing novel
broad-spectrum antiviral therapeutics that target the replication process of influenza virus,
coronaviruses (including SARS-CoV-2 and MERS), norovirus, and hepatitis C virus.

[Learn More][34]

### Technology

We utilize unique structure-based technologies and Nobel Prize winning expertise to create first-
and best-in-class antiviral drugs.

[Learn More][35]

### Development Programs

Our development programs include a wide variety of serious and/or chronic viral diseases including
influenza, COVID-19, hepatitis C and gastroenteritis caused by norovirus.

[Learn More][36]

We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing novel therapeutics to meet the growing
global need for effective, safe antiviral treatments.  We employ a unique structure-based drug
discovery technology platform and Nobel Prize-winning expertise to create viable antiviral drugs.
 Our antivirals target the replication process and are designed to be safe, broad-spectrum,
resistant and convenient to administer.

We are quickly and efficiently advancing multiple antiviral candidates with clinical programs for
norovirus, influenza and coronaviruses, while also discovering and developing antiviral compounds
for other high-value indications.

## Targeted Solutions for Viral Diseases

Novel antiviral therapeutics for the treatment of serious and/or chronic viral diseases including
influenza, COVID-19, hepatitis C and gastroenteritis caused by norovirus.

[View Product Pipeline][33]

### About Us

Cocrystal Pharma, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company discovering and developing novel
broad-spectrum antiviral therapeutics that target the replication process of influenza virus,
coronaviruses (including SARS-CoV-2 and MERS), norovirus, and hepatitis C virus.

[Learn More][34]

### Technology

We utilize unique structure-based technologies and Nobel Prize winning expertise to create first-
and best-in-class antiviral drugs.

[Learn More][35]

### Development Programs

Our development programs include a wide variety of serious and/or chronic viral diseases including
influenza, COVID-19, hepatitis C and gastroenteritis caused by norovirus.

[Learn More][36]

all_classified.polished_summary: Enzene Biosciences is a continuously innovative development and manufacturing organization (CIDMO) specializing in biologics, offering comprehensive solutions in drug discovery, development, and manufacturing. With a focus on affordability and efficiency, Enzene provides services such as antibody discovery, custom reagents, and drug substance manufacturing, targeting both human and animal health markets. The company is committed to advancing biologics innovation while ensuring quality assurance and regulatory compliance.

The company provides comprehensive coverage of industry trends, funding activities, and innovative therapies, catering to professionals and stakeholders in the life sciences and healthcare markets. Through its various platforms, Fierce Biotech aims to inform and connect the biotech community, facilitating advancements in research and development.

# Bicazer 50mg

Molecular Salt: [Bicalutamide][9]

#### Bicazer 50mg

#### Composition – Bicalutamide 50 mg

#### Classification – Anticancer drug

### What is Bicazer 50mg?

Bicazer 50 mg is the bicalutamide tablet.

It is manufactured by Aprazer Healthcare.

Bicazer 50 mg is a WHO standard anti-androgen medicine.

Bicazer 50 mg is the trusted anticancer medicine for prostate cancer.

### Why choose Bicazer 50mg by Aprazer Healthcare?

Aprazer Healthcare is the top Indian pharmaceuticals manufacturing company.

Manufacturing the global quality drugs, we are the leading pharma exporters from India.

We manufacture the highest quality lifesaving medicines, including –
* • Anticancer medicines
* • HIV medicines
* • Hepatitis B medicines
* • Hepatitis C medicines

### What is Bicazer 50mg Used for?

Bicazer 50 mg is used widely for the treatment of –
* • Advanced prostate cancer – It slows down the prostate cancer growth.
* • Metastasized prostate cancer – It is used to treat prostate cancer that has spread to different
parts of the body.

It is used with luteinizing hormone.

It prevents the hormonal flare caused by the drug.

### How Does Bicazer 50mg Work?

It inhibits the testosterone receptors.

It inhibits testosterone binding.

It reduces cancer cell proliferation and growth.

It helps shrink the prostate tumor.

### What Are the Bicazer 50 Mg (Bicalutamide) Side Effects?

Bicalutamide inhibits the hormonal signaling.

It leads to little fluctuation in hormones.
* • Hot flashes
* • Sudden sweating
* • Weakness
* • Nausea
* • Fluid retention
* • Reduced hemoglobin
* • Skin rashes
* • Constipation
* • Weight gain
* • Dizziness

#### Favikast 400 (Favipiravir 400mg) Tablets Uses

It has a broad spectrum of activity.

It is widely used in the context of viral outbreaks.

It inhibits DNA synthesis.

It stops the cell multiplication and replication.

### How Favikast 400 (Favipiravir 400mg) Tablets Cause Side Effects?

It causes several GIT side effects.

It increases uric acid synthesis.

It increases liver enzymes. It increases stress in the liver.

* Abdominal pain

* Increased levels of triglycerides

Favikast 400 (Favipiravir 400mg) Tablet’s Serious Side Effects

Favikast 400 (Favipiravir 400mg) Tablets Precautions

#### To be used carefully under observation in -
* Liver disorders
* Gout
* Children
* Elderly people
* Kidney disorders
* Bleeding disorders
* Heart issues
* Diabetes

Long-term use of Favikast (favipiravir 400 mg) tablet should be monitored for
* Liver functions

* Uric acid levels

Sobiaxis is a sodium bicarbonate tablet manufactured by Aprazer Healthcare.

It is globally available and widely used for acidity and heartburn.

Sobiaxis is a widely available over-the-counter antacid medicine.

#### Aprazer Healthcare – The Pharmaceutical leaders

### Where is the Sobiaxis (Sodium Bicarbonate) Tablet Used?

It is widely used to neutralize excess acid in the stomach.

#### It is used to treat –
* Acidosis
* Indigestion
* Treat heartburn
* Alkalizing urine
* In severe diarrhea

### What is the Working of Sobiaxis (Sodium Bicarbonate) Tablets?

It is widely used to neutralize acid.

It increases the PH of the urine and the stomach.

In diarrhea, it replaces the lost salts.

It eliminates toxic substances from the body.

The Sobiaxis (Sodium Bicarbonate) Tablet Side Effects

It affects the PH of the stomach.

It neutralizes the acid and releases carbon dioxide.

#### It causes –
* Stomach cramps
* Dry mouth
* Frequent urination

### What Are the Sobiaxis (Sodium Bicarbonate) Severe Side Effects?

It can cause severe side effects when used for the long term.

It disrupts the PH of the body.

It can cause metabolic alkalosis.

It can increase blood PH.

It can cause changes in electrolyte levels.
* Fluid retention
* Difficulty in breathing
* Muscle firing or twitching
* Nausea
* Vomiting

#### Sobiaxis (Sodium Bicarbonate) Precautions

It contains sodium. A high amount of sodium can lead to ion imbalances.

#### It should be cautiously used in -
* Kidney disorders
* High blood pressure
* Heart disorders
* liver disease
* Electrolyte imbalances
* Appendicitis
* Active stomach ulcers
* Intestinal bleeding
* Bone disorders

### What Are the Drugs That React With Sobiaxis (Sodium Bicarbonate)?

It alters the gastric PH. It reduces the efficacy of the drugs.
* Antibiotics
* NSAIDS
* Cardiac medicines
* BP medicines
* Diuretic medicines
* Anti-fungal medicines
* Iron supplements
* Hormone drugs
* Digoxin

# Bethkast

#### Bethkast

#### Composition – Bethanechol Chloride Tablets

#### Classification – Urinary Retention Medicine

### What is Bethkast (Bethanechol Chloride) Tablet?

Bethkast is a bethanechol chloride tablet, manufactured by Aprazer Healthcare.

It is used in post-operative urinary retention.

Bethkast, available globally, is used for postpartum urinary complications.

Aprazer Healthcare – The Top Medicine Manufacturer

Aprazer Healthcare is the top pharmaceutical manufacturing company in India.

It manufactures the widest range of pharmaceutical products.

It specializes in manufacturing specialty care medicines.

As a leading manufacturer of high-quality drugs, we are the primary exporter of pharmaceuticals to
countries worldwide.

With WHO-GMP-qualified manufacturing capacities, it adheres to stringent quality controls.

#### Bethkast (Bethanechol Chloride) Tablet Uses

The urinary muscle loses its tonicity after surgery or childbirth.

The muscles are not able to contract.

It leads to urinary retention.

#### It is used in –
* Post-operative urinary retention
* Post-partum urinary retention
* Atony of the urinary bladder

#### Working of Bethkast (Bethanechol Chloride) Tablet

It mimics acetylcholine. It stimulates the muscular contractions.

It binds to receptors in the bladder. It helps release the urine.

It increases GIT motility.

### What Are the Bethkast (Bethanechol Chloride) Side Effects?

It stimulates the nervous system.

The motility in the stomach is increased.

It causes GIT side effects.
* Abdominal pain
* Muscle cramps
* Diarrhea
* Sweating
* Flushing
* Dizziness
* Headache
* Frequent urination

### What Are the Bethkast (Bethanechol Chloride) Tablet Severe Side Effects?

It binds to muscarinic receptors in the body.

It causes prolonged stimulation.

#### It can lead to –
* Irregular heartbeat
* Difficulty in breathing
* Increase acidity
* Forceful bladder contraction
* Overstimulate the thyroid gland

### What Are Bethkast (Bethanechol Chloride) Tablet Precautions?

Avoid using alcohol. It causes dizziness.

It should be carefully monitored for high doses.

It can cause overstimulation.

#### It should not be used in cases of -
* Asthma
* Cardiovascular disorders
* Ulcers
* Parkinson’s
* Intestinal surgeries
* Thyroid dysfunction

### What to Avoid With Bethkast (Bethanechol Chloride) Tablet?

It should not be given with other stimulants.

It can cause overstimulation /contraction.
* Anticholinergic drugs
* Beta blockers
* Cholinergic drugs

### What is the Warning With Bethkast (Bethanechol Chloride) Tablet?

It has a narrow safety margin. The therapeutic dose should be carefully determined.

#### It should not be used in –
* Children below 12 years of age
* Severe liver and kidney dysfunction
* Mechanical urinary obstruction

#### It should be used cautiously in -

In old people, it can cause fall in blood pressure.

In pregnancy or lactation.

#### Conclusion

Bethkast (bethanechol chloride) is widely used post-surgery.

It must be taken empty stomach.

It can cause hypotension. Stand up slowly.

Driving must be avoided as it causes dizziness.

### What is Oxazer 100mg Injection?

Aprazer Healthcare manufactures Oxazer 100 mg.

Oxazer 100 mg is an oxaliplatin injection.

It is a readily available anticancer injection.

It is used in colorectal cancer.

### Where is Oxazer (Oxaliplatin Injection) Used?

It is widely used in combination with other drugs.
* Colorectal cancer
* Colon cancer
* Gastrointestinal cancers
* Solid tumors

Aprazer Healthcare – The Oncology Injectable Manufacturer

Aprazer Healthcare is a manufacturer of anticancer drugs.

It manufactures a variety of cancer drugs.
* Oral anticancer medicines
* Anticancer injections

It is a global quality drug manufacturer.

Aprazer Healthcare is capable of manufacturing advanced drug formulations.
* SR release tablets
* Syringes(prefilled)

We export anticancer drugs worldwide. We are the largest anticancer drug exporter.

#### Oxazer (Oxaliplatin Injection) Working

It is a platinum-containing medicine.

It causes crosslinking of the DNA strands.

It inhibits the synthesis and replication of DNA.

It leads to cell death.

### What Are the Oxazer (Oxaliplatin Injection) Side Effects?

It causes bone marrow suppression. It reduces blood cell count.
* Low platelets
* Anemia
* Increased risk of infections
* GIT upset – Nausea, diarrhea
* Mouth ulcers
* Hair loss
* Numbness in hands and feet

Oxazer (Oxaliplatin Injection) Severe Side Effects

Oxazer (oxaliplatin injection) is cytotoxic. It leads to the accumulation of platinum in the nerves.

It causes injury to the organs.

It lowers the blood count.

It increases the risk of serious infections.

#### It can lead to –
* Liver dysfunction
* Kidney dysfunction
* Cardiac effects
* Lung damage
* Neuropathy

#### Oxazer (Oxaliplatin Injection) Precautions

It increases the risk of infection.

Avoid exposure to cold conditions.

Avoid getting pregnant.

Drink water. It can reduce GIT troubles.

#### To be used cautiously in patients with –
* Pre-existing liver disorders
* Bleeding disorders
* Low platelet count
* Kidney disorders
* Pre-existing nerve damage
* Hypocalcaemia
* Hypo magnesia

### What Are the Warnings With Oxazer (Oxaliplatin Injection)?

It should be used only after a prescription.

#### It must be avoided in-
* Allergy or hypersensitivity
* Breastfeeding mothers
* women who are pregnant

### Monitoring Considerations for Oxazer (Oxaliplatin Injection)?

It is important to monitor effects while administering the oxaliplatin injection.

It has a narrow safety margin.

#### It should be monitored for –
* Total blood count
* Numbness
* Pain
* Tingling sensation
* Liver function
* Kidney function
* Electrolyte imbalance
* Respiratory functions
* Cardiac functions

### How to Store and Use Oxazer (Oxaliplatin Injection)?

Store the vial at normal temperature.

It must be protected from light.

The diluted solution can be stored for 24 hours at 2-8 degrees Celsius.

It must be given as a slow IV infusion only.

It should not be diluted with sodium chloride /chloride components.

It leads to precipitation.

### What Drugs Cannot Be Given in Oxazer (Oxaliplatin Injection)?

Several interactions increase the risk of infections.

It can cause cardiac effects, bleeding, and infection.

#### Avoid its use with -
* Live vaccines
* Nephrotoxic drugs
* Anticoagulants
* Antiplatelet
* Myelosuppressive drugs

#### Conclusion

Oxazer (oxaliplatin injection) is harmful.

It should be carefully handled.

Avoid contact with the skin.

It can irritate the site of injection.

#### Classification – Folic Acid Derivative

### What is Leucokast 50 Injection?

Leucokast 50 mg injection is a leucovorin injection manufactured by Aprazer Healthcare.

It is widely used as a cancer supportive treatment.

Leucokast (leucovorin injection) is used to rescue healthy cells after anticancer treatment.

It is used in anticancer therapies that interrupt the folic acid synthesis in the body.

Aprazer Healthcare – The Largest Oncology Injectable Manufacturer

Aprazer Healthcare is the leading anticancer drug manufacturer in India.

It manufactures global standard anticancer drugs.

Aprazer Healthcare is the largest anticancer injection exporter to countries worldwide.

It manufactures the largest range of anticancer injections.
* Leucokast 50 – Leucovorin injection
* Carbokast 150 – Carboplatin injection
* Daunozer 20 - Daunorubicin Injection
* Nab Paclikast 100 – Paclikast injection

### What Are Leucokast 50 (Leucovorin Injection) Uses?

It is widely used as a folic acid rescue therapy.

#### It is used to recover normal body cells after-
* Methotrexate therapy
* Trimethoprim and methotrexate therapy

It is used as an adjuvant to (5-FU). It enhances its effects.

### How Does Leucokast 50 (Leucovorin Injection) Work?

#### Folic Acid Rescue Agent -
* The anticancer therapy depletes the folic acid synthesis.
* The leucovorin injection is a folic acid derivative.
* It recovers the folic acid levels in the body.
* Folic acid is essential for cell growth.

#### Adjuvant to Fluorouracil Drugs -
* It enhances the chemotherapy effect.
* It prolongs the action of fluorouracil (5-FU) drugs.
* 5–FU compounds can bind strongly to the enzyme.
* It inhibits cancer cell synthesis.

### What Are Leucokast (Leucovorin Injection) Side Effects?

#### Gastrointestinal side effects include-
* Nausea
* Tiredness
* Vomiting
* Mouth sores
* Skin rashes
* Hair loss

### How Does Leucokast (Leucovorin Injection) Lead to Severe Side Effects?

It is used with Fluorouracil compounds. It can cause toxic effects.

It can cause a reaction (allergy).
* Flu-like symptoms
* Severe skin allergy
* Rashes and itchiness
* Swelling in the face

#### It can cause CNS side effects-
* Fainting
* Seizures
* Confusion

Warnings for the Use of Leucokast (Leucovorin Injection)-

It should be used under a doctor’s supervision.

It is prescription medicine.

Not to be used as a folate supplement.

It must not be injected into the spine.

#### Not to be used if any previous allergy

It should not be used for anemia.

It must be avoided in breastfeeding mothers.

### What Drugs Cannot Be Given With Leucokast (Leucovorin Injection)?

It can show serious drug interactions.

It can lead to toxicity.

#### It should not be given with -
* Anti-seizure drugs
* Supplements
* Vitamins
* Certain anticancer medicines

### Who Should Not Use Leucokast (Leucovorin Injection)?

Avoid in people with vitamin B-12 deficiency.

#### To be used carefully in conditions like-
* Epilepsy
* Kidney disorders
* Liver disorders
* Bleeding disorders
* Gastrointestinal disorder

#### It requires regular monitoring of –
* Blood cell count
* Liver functions
* Electrolyte balance
* Calcium levels
* Vitamin B-12 levels

### How to Store and Use Leucokast (Leucovorin Injection)?

The injection needs to be stored at low temperatures.

The injection is to be kept at 2-8 degrees Celsius.

Do not freeze the injection.

Keep away from light.

To be used as IV and IM.

Use the solution (diluted) immediately.

It reduces pain and swelling in the joint.

# Imatib 100mg Tablet

Molecular Salt: [Imatinib mesylate][9]

Imatib 100 Tablet has a wide range of cancer treatments available. Blood malignancies (such as
chronic myeloid leukemia and acute lymphocytic leukemia) and stromal tumors of the gastrointestinal
tract are the most common indications for its prescription. The process is effective because it
focuses in on particular proteins that fuel cancer cell proliferation and metastasis.

Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, a skin tumor, and aggressive systemic mastocytosis, a bone marrow
disorder, are two other conditions that Imatib 100 Tablet is used to treat. For optimal results,
take the medication alongside a meal. Make sure you take it at the same time every day for the best
results. Take it for the whole duration recommended by your doctor. Your treatment length will be
determined by your specific needs and how well you respond to the treatment. Serious adverse effects
might occur if taken incorrectly or in excess. You shouldn't stop taking it unless your doctor
advises you to, even if the advantages might not be noticeable for a while.

Edema, nausea, vomiting, cramping in the muscles and skeletal muscles, diarrhea, rash, exhaustion,
and stomach discomfort are among the most often reported adverse effects of this medication. If your
weight increases suddenly and unexpectedly, you should consult your doctor. While using this
medication, your doctor may recommend checking your liver function and blood cell counts on a
frequent basis. If you feel lightheaded or have hazy vision, you should not drive or perform
anything else that requires you to concentrate mentally.

Make sure your healthcare team is aware of all the medications you are taking, as this medicine can
interact with or be affected by many others. Neither pregnancy nor breastfeeding should be
undertaken while using this medication. It is crucial that both sexes take efficient contraception
during treatment in order to prevent conception.

#### Indication
* Treatment of Cancer

#### Benefits

#### In Treatment of Cancer

Imatib 100 Tablet aims to inhibit the spread and proliferation of cancer cells in a number of
different cancer types, including those of the blood, gastrointestinal stromal tumors, skin
(dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans), and bone marrow (aggressive systemic mastocytosis). The drug
inhibits or halts cancer cell development by blocking these proteins. This alleviates pain, reduces
tumor size, and slows tumor growth.

#### Side effects

Most side effects don't need to be treated by a doctor, and they go away as your body adapts to the
medicine. You should consult your doctor if the symptoms continue or if you are concerned.

#### Common side effects of Imatib 100 Tablet
* Edema (swelling)
* Nausea
* Vomiting
* Muscle cramp
* Musculoskeletal (bone, muscle or joint) pain
* Diarrhea
* Rash
* Fatigue
* Abdominal pain
* Bleeding
* Breathing problems
* Cough
* Weight gain
* Dry eye
* Dizziness
* Hemorrhage

#### How to use

Take this medication as prescribed by your doctor in the dosage and time frame specified. Take it
all in at once. Avoid chewing, crushing or breaking it in any way. For optimal results, take Imatib
100 Tablet alongside a meal.

#### How it works

Imatib 100 Tablet is a drug that fights cancer. One of the protein enzymes that causes cancer cells
to develop abnormally is bcr-abl tyrosine kinase. The drug stops bcr-abl positive cells (cancer
cells) from multiplying and makes them perish out (apoptosis). This is the mechanism by which it
inhibits or delays the progression of cancer.

#### Precautions

#### Alcohol – UNSAFE

It's not known if Imatib 100 Tablet and alcohol are compatible. Please seek medical advice.

#### Pregnancy - SAFE IF PRESCRIBED

Imatib 100 Tablet is unsafe for Pregnant women, as there is clear evidence of harm to the unborn.
However, if the advantages outweigh the potential hazards, the doctor may prescribe it in specific
life-threatening cases. Please seek medical advice.

#### Breast feeding - UNSAFE

Use of Imatib 100 Tablet while breast-feeding is most likely harmful to the infant. The medicine may
enter into the breast milk and harm the baby, according to a minimal amount of human data.

It is important for lactating mothers to refrain from breastfeeding for at least 15 days after
discontinuing this medication.

#### Driving - SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

Imatib 100 Tablet may induce negative effects that impair your driving ability.

#### Kidney – SAFE IF PRESCRIBED

In patients with kidney disease, Imatib 100 Tablet should be taken with caution. Imatib 100 Tablet
dosage may need to be adjusted. Please seek medical advice.

#### Liver – CAUTION

In patients with severe liver disease, Imatib 100 Tablet should be taken with caution. Imatib 100
Tablet dosage may need to be adjusted. Please seek medical advice.

#### Tips

For best results, take it with a meal and plenty of water to avoid nausea.

Weak vision or dizziness could be side effects. Prior to determining its effects, refrain from
driving or engaging in activities that need concentration.

Imatib 100 Tablet frequently causes adverse effects such as swelling and water retention. If your
weight increases suddenly and unexpectedly, you should consult your doctor.

Without your doctor's approval, do not alter the dosage or stop taking the medication.

Any and all drugs, including those available without a prescription and any nutritional supplements
you may be taking, should be discussed with your doctor.

Your doctor might prescribe blood tests on a regular basis to track your liver function and blood
cell count.

Imatib 100 Tablet should be taken exactly as prescribed; skipping a dose will not affect the next
scheduled dose. Do not take two doses at once.

# Heptavir 150mg Tablet

Molecular Salt: [Lamivudine][9]

Heptavir 150mg Tablet is administered to patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection and
HIV infection. It inhibits the proliferation of viruses in human cells. This procedure prevents the
virus from generating new viruses and resolves your infection.

Although it can reduce HIV levels in the body, Heptavir 150 mg Tablet cannot cure HIV or AIDS. In
addition to extending your life expectancy, this also reduces your risk of developing HIV-related
problems. It is often given alongside other medications for HIV. Your doctor will assess your
condition, prescribe medications, and determine the optimal dosage for you. Ensure that you adhere
to the instructions for all medications that are prescribed to you. Take it with or without meals.
The effectiveness of these medications and the likelihood that HIV will develop a resistance to them
are both enhanced by taking them regularly at the prescribed intervals. Do not stop taking the
medication until your doctor permits you to discontinue it.

This medication often causes the following unwanted effects: nausea, vomiting, diarrhea,
indigestion, stomach discomfort, joint pain, and headaches. If it lasts for more than a few days,
you should see a doctor. These are normally not cause for concern, but it's important to inform your
doctor if they cause you distress or persist. Skin reactions or liver damage are very rare side
effects. These are things that your doctor will keep an eye out for when you're first starting
therapy.

It is recommended to consult your physician before use if you have a history of skin conditions,
liver illness, or kidney disease. To monitor your liver function and blood counts while taking it,
you may require frequent blood tests. You should stay away from alcohol because it can harm your
liver. Before utilizing this medication, pregnant or breastfeeding mothers should consult their
physician. It is important to avoid sharing personal goods such as razors or toothbrushes if you are
HIV positive, and to never have intercourse without protection. To learn more about safe methods,
such as condoms, to avoid contracting HIV during sexual activity, consult your doctor.

#### Indication
* Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection

#### Benefits

#### In Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection

Heptavir 150 mg Tablet is effective in treating chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infections by
blocking the virus's ability to replicate. It improves immune system function and aids in infection
control. Complications are less likely to occur, and quality of life is enhanced. Always take this
medication with another antiretroviral drug. You shouldn't use it to prevent HBV infection, and it
isn't a cure either. You must adhere to the dose instructions provided by your doctor when using
this medication. The efficacy of the medication is substantially enhanced when all doses are taken
at the correct times and in the correct volumes.

#### Side effects

Most side effects don't need to be treated by a doctor, and they go away as your body adapts to the
medicine. You should consult your doctor if the symptoms continue or if you are concerned.

#### Common side effects of Heptavir 150mg Tablet
* Headache
* Nausea
* Diarrhea
* Vomiting
* Fatigue
* Stomach pain
* Rash

#### How to use

Take this medication as prescribed by your doctor in the dosage and time frame specified. Take it
all in at once. Avoid chewing, crushing, or breaking it in any way. It is best to take Heptavir
150mg Tablet at the same time each day, with or without a meal.

#### How it works

Heptavir 150mg Tablet is a medicine that eliminates viruses. It stops the virus from replicating in
human cells. In addition to curing your infection, this also prevents the virus from replicating.

#### Precautions

#### Alcohol – UNSAFE

Heptavir 150mg Tablet users should take caution when drinking alcohol. Please seek medical advice.

#### Pregnancy - SAFE IF PRESCRIBED

Heptavir 150mg Tablet may be unsafe to use during pregnancy. However, there is a lack of human
research despite evidence of minimal or no harm to the foetus from those conducted on animals.
However, if the advantages outweigh the potential hazards, the doctor may prescribe it in specific
life-threatening cases. Please seek medical advice.

#### Breastfeeding - UNSAFE

It's likely safe to take Heptavir 150mg Tablet during breastfeeding. There is not enough information
about the drug's effects on humans to determine if it poses a serious risk to the unborn child.

#### Driving - SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

Heptavir 150mg Tablet generally does not impair your ability to drive.

#### Kidney – SAFE IF PRESCRIBED

In patients with kidney disease, Heptavir 150mg Tablet should be taken with caution. Heptavir 150mg
Tablet dosage may need to be adjusted. Please seek medical advice.

#### Liver – CAUTION

Patients with kidney conditions can safely take Heptavir 150mg tablets. There is no need to modify
the dosage of Heptavir 150mg Tablet.

#### Tips

Patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection are given Heptavir 150mg tablets.

The treatment of HIV infections involves the use of this drug in conjunction with others.

The drug will be absorbed more fully into the body if taken with food.

You might feel drowsy or dizzy after taking Heptavir 150mg Tablet. Until you know how it affects
you, do not drive or do anything that requires attention.

It is still possible for you to have infections or other viral-related disorders while taking this
medicine.

Spreading HIV or HBV is another possibility. Never share a needle or anything else that could
potentially come into contact with blood or other bodily fluids.

Blood tests are necessary to monitor your liver function, hepatitis B virus level, and blood cell
count during treatment and for at least six months after quitting this medication.

It is important to take the missed dose of Heptavir 150mg Tablet without delay. Nevertheless, if
your next dose is approaching, you should not take the missed dose and return to your usual
schedule. Do not take two doses at once.

# Udikast 300 Tablet

Molecular Salt: [Ursodeoxycholic Acid][9]

#### Udikast 300 Tablet

Udikast 300 Tablet is used to dissolve specific gallstones and prevent their formation. Another
condition that it helps with is primary biliary cirrhosis, which is a liver illness. It assists in
the digestion of cholesterol that has transformed into gallbladder stones, thereby dissolving them.

It is recommended to take Udikast 300 Tablet whole, preferably after a meal, with a glass of water
or milk. Your body weight and the ailment being treated will determine the dosage. For optimal
results, take it consistently for the recommended duration (several months or more). Even if your
symptoms go away, you should continue taking it.

Nausea, rash, itching, diarrhea, hair loss, and abdominal pain are the most often reported side
effects of this medication. Not all people experience these negative consequences. Tell your doctor
if you're worried about them or if they don't disappear.

Any inflammation of the gallbladder or bile ducts, frequent cramp-like pain in the upper abdomen,
blood in the cough, or rapid weight gain should be reported to the doctor before starting this
medication. Please inform your doctor of all the medications you are taking, since this medication
may interact with others to either enhance or decrease their effectiveness. Because of the increased
risk of gallstone formation, women taking hormonal birth control tablets should stop using them
immediately. Ultrasound scans or regular blood tests to monitor liver function may be necessary
throughout treatment.

#### Indication
* • Treatment of Primary Biliary Cirrhosis
* • Treatment of Gallbladder Stones

#### Benefits

#### In the Treatment of Primary Biliary Cirrhosis

The liver condition known as primary biliary cholangitis worsens with time. Eventually, it can cause
liver failure, though it is not always symptomatic. You can treat this problem with Udikast 300
Tablet on its own or in combination with other medications. Most people can avoid or postpone liver
damage with its aid, particularly if taken early on. You should expect to take this medication
forever once you begin treatment. Quitting smoking, maintaining a healthy weight, and limiting
alcohol consumption will help the medication work better and improve your overall health.

#### In the Treatment of Gallbladder Stones

Udikast 300 Tablet is a medication that assists in the reduction of cholesterol production by the
liver. Cholesterol "stones" deposited in the gallbladder can be more easily broken down with its
aid. It may take several months for the stone to dissolve entirely, so it's important to take the
medication consistently for the whole duration suggested by your doctor. Get in touch with your
doctor since there may be further medications and lifestyle adjustments that might lower your
cholesterol and decrease the likelihood of gallstones.

#### Side effects

Most side effects don't need to be treated by a doctor, and they go away as your body adapts to the
medicine. You should consult your doctor if the symptoms continue or if you are concerned.

#### Common side effects of Udikast 300 Tablet
* • Abdominal pain
* • Diarrhea
* • Hair loss
* • Itching
* • Nausea
* • Rash

#### How to use

Take this medication as prescribed by your doctor in the dosage and time frame specified. Take it
all in at once. Avoid chewing, crushing, or breaking it in any way. It is best to take Udikast 300
Tablet at the same time each day, with a meal.

#### How it works

The medicine Udikast 300 Tablet helps to protect the liver. This medication functions by decreasing
the concentration of cholesterol in the bloodstream and aiding in the dissolution of gallbladder
stones, which are primarily composed of cholesterol. In addition, it enhances liver enzymes,
safeguards liver cells from destruction by deleterious bile acids, and enhances liver function.

#### Precautions

#### Alcohol – UNSAFE

When taken alongside alcohol, Udikast 300 Tablet may cause excessive drowsiness.

#### Pregnancy - SAFE IF PRESCRIBED

It is believed that Udikast 300 Tablet is safe to take during pregnancy. However, there is a lack of
human research despite evidence of minimal or no harm to the foetus from those conducted on animals.

#### Breastfeeding - UNSAFE

It's likely safe to take Udikast 300 Tablet during breastfeeding. There is not enough information
about the drug's effects on humans to determine if it poses a serious risk to the unborn child.

#### Driving - SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

Udikast 300 Tablet generally does not impair your ability to drive.

#### Kidney – SAFE IF PRESCRIBED

There is a lack of data about the usage of Udikast 300 tablets in individuals who have kidney
disease. Please seek medical advice.

#### Liver – CAUTION

There is a lack of data about the usage of Udikast 300 tablets in individuals who have kidney
disease. Please seek medical advice.

#### Tips

Udikast 300 Tablet should be consumed with a glass of water or milk following a meal.

Stick to a balanced diet, get plenty of exercise, and cut off alcohol.

A side effect that could happen is diarrhea. Make sure you stay hydrated and let your doctor know if
you continue to experience diarrhea or if you notice blood in your stools.

Depending on your condition, your doctor may recommend monthly liver function tests and bilirubin
monitoring for the first three months of treatment and then every six months after that.

Do not discontinue use of the medication without first consulting your doctor.

Keep taking Udikast 300 Tablet as prescribed, even if you forget to take a dose. Do not take two
doses at once.

# Etovel 50 Capsule

Molecular Salt: [Etoposide][9]

#### Etovel 50 Capsule

Etovel 50 Capsule treats a variety of testicular and lung cancers. On occasion, it can be used to
treat several different forms of cancer in men and women. It is sometimes administered in
combination with other medications for chemotherapy, although it can also be used alone.

To maximize the benefits, it is recommended that the Etovel 50 Capsule be consumed on an empty
stomach. However, it is more effective to take the capsule at the same time. Please consider it as
the recommendation of your physician. The dosage and frequency of administration are based upon the
intended purpose. Your doctor will determine the dosage that is necessary to alleviate your
symptoms. Swallow the medicine whole water. Keep taking this medication for the full duration of
your doctor's treatment. It can weaken your immune system, so stay away from people suffering from a
cold or any other infection.

The most prevalent adverse reactions to this medication include anemia (low red blood cell count),
nausea, vomiting, hair loss, and low blood platelet counts. Consult your doctor if these cause you
distress or seem severe. There may be methods to lessen or eliminate them. Using an effective method
of birth control to prevent pregnancy or fatherhood is of the utmost importance throughout therapy.

Tell your doctor if you've ever had radiation treatment, have liver or kidney problems, or are
taking any other medications that could affect this medication. Because many other medications may
affect the way this medicine works or reduce its effectiveness, your doctor must be aware of all
your medications. Notify your doctor if you are expecting a child or are currently lactating. While
you are on this medication, your doctor may monitor your liver function and blood cell counts.

#### Indication
* Small-cell lung cancer
* Testicular cancer

#### Benefits

#### In small-cell lung cancer

Smoking is the primary cause of small-cell lung cancer, a rapidly expanding cancer that begins with
small tumors in the lungs and can spread to other organs. Whether used alone or in conjunction with
other medications, Etovel 50 Capsule helps in the treatment of such kinds of cancer. You and your
doctor must consider the advantages and hazards of this powerful and highly toxic medication. It is
important to refrain from consuming alcohol throughout this treatment and to ensure proper hydration
by drinking enough of water.

#### In Testicular cancer

Testicular cancer is a form of cancer that affects the testicles, which are male organs that produce
sperm and hormones. A loose pouch of skin called the scrotum lies beneath the penis and contains the
testicles. Etovel 50 Capsule inhibits the multiplication of cancer cells in men and kills or
prevents the development of cancer cells.

#### Side effects

Most side effects don't need to be treated by a doctor, and they go away as your body adapts to the
medicine. You should consult your doctor if the symptoms continue or if you are concerned.

#### Common side effects of Etovel 50 Capsule
* Anemia (low number of red blood cells)
* Decreased blood cells (red cells, white cells, and platelets)
* Decreased white blood cell count
* Diarrhea
* Hair loss
* Liver damage
* Low blood platelets
* Nausea
* Rash
* Stomatitis (Inflammation of the mouth)
* Vomiting

#### How to use

Adhere to your doctor's instructions regarding the dosage and duration of time you should take this
medication. It is recommended to take Etovel 50 Capsules without food.

#### How it works

Etovel 50 Capsule is a medication that treats cancer. It inhibits topoisomerase II, an enzyme that
cancer cells use to replicate their DNA. Cancer cells are slowed down in their proliferation and
eventually eradicated by this.

#### Precautions

#### Alcohol – UNSAFE

It's not known if Etovel 50 Capsule and alcohol are compatible. Please seek medical advice.

#### Pregnancy -SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

Etovel 50 Capsule is unsafe for Pregnant women, as there is clear evidence of harm to the unborn.
However, if the advantages outweigh the potential hazards, the doctor may prescribe it in specific
life-threatening cases. Please seek medical advice.

#### Breastfeeding - UNSAFE

It is not recommended to take Etovel 50 Capsule while lactating. The medicine may be hazardous to
the baby, according to data.

#### Driving - SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

Etovel 50 Capsule generally does not impair your ability to drive.

#### Kidney – SAFE IF PRESCRIBED

In patients with severe kidney disease, Etovel 50 Capsule should be taken with caution. The Etovel
50 Capsule dosage may need to be adjusted. Please seek medical advice. Etovel 50 Capsule should not
be used by individuals who have advanced kidney disease.

#### Liver – CAUTION

In patients with severe liver disease, Etovel 50 Capsule should be taken with caution. The Etovel 50
Capsule dosage may need to be adjusted. Please seek medical advice.

Etovel 50 Capsule should not be used by individuals who have advanced liver disease.

#### Tips

The Etovel 50 Capsule should be consumed on an empty stomach.

Complete the course following your physician's instructions and refrain from skipping any doses.

While taking this medication, it is crucial to use an effective method of birth control to prevent
pregnancy.

Your physician may administer routine blood tests to monitor your electrolyte levels, liver
function, and blood cell count.

Notify your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following symptoms: a rash, difficulty
breathing, shortness of breath, or swelling of the tongue.

# Bracanat 150mg Tablet

Molecular Salt: [Olaparib][9]

#### Bracanat 150mg Tablet

Breast cancer and ovarian cancer are treated with Bracanat 150mg Tablet. Depending on your doctor's
recommendations, you will be prescribed the correct dosage and frequency of use and depending on the
condition you're being treated for, this may vary from time to time Take it exactly as directed by
your doctor as taking it in the wrong manner or overdosing on it can result in side effects. Do not
stop taking it until your doctor instructs you to do so as It may take several weeks or months
before you see or experience any improvement.

Make sure to inform your doctor if you suffer heart, liver or kidney problems, or if you are taking
any medication to treat infections before taking it. You should inform your doctor about any other
medications you are taking because this medication can interact with or be affected by them. This
medication should not be taken by pregnant women or nursing mothers. During therapy, it is critical
that both men and women use reliable methods of birth control to avoid becoming pregnant.

#### Indication
* Treatment of Breast cancer
* Treatment of Ovarian cancer

#### Benefits

#### In Breast cancer

Breast cancer patients may benefit from Bracanat 150mg Tablet alone or in conjunction with other
medications or treatment methodologies such as chemotherapy. Breast lumps, bloody discharge from the
nipples, and changes in the breast's shape or texture can all be alleviated with this treatment.
Bracanat 150mg Tablet vanishes or prevents the growth of cancer cells and also prevents cancer
cells from growing. Consider bringing up any concerns about side effects with your doctor.

#### In Ovarian cancer

In women, ovarian cancer develops in the ovaries, which generate the female reproductive system's
eggs (ovaries). This form of cancer is often discovered far too late and is often fatal.
Predominantly it is seen in the pelvis and the stomach. A cancer cell's growth is eliminated or
inhibited by Bracanat 150mg Tablet, which also prevents the proliferation of cancer cells. Despite
its effectiveness, there are some negative effects to consider. The best thing you can do to avoid
these adverse effects is to consult your doctor.

#### Side effects

Most side effects don't need to be treated by a doctor, and they go away as your body adapts to the
medicine. You should consult your doctor if the symptoms continue or if you are concerned.

#### Common side effects of Bracanat 150mg Tablet
* Nausea
* Fatigue
* Anemia (low number of red blood cells)
* Vomiting
* Diarrhea
* Decreased blood cells (red cells, white cells, and platelets)
* Taste change
* Cough
* Breathlessness
* Indigestion
* Abdominal pain
* Loss of appetite
* Headache

#### How to use

Take this medication as prescribed by your doctor in the dosage and time frame specified. Take it
all in at once. Avoid chewing, crushing or breaking it in any way.

#### How it works

Bracanat 150mg Tablet is an anticancer medication. It functions by preventing the proliferation of
specific tumor cell lines in vitro and reducing tumor growth in both monotherapy and
post-chemotherapy scenarios.

#### Precautions

#### Alcohol – UNSAFE

#### SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

It's not known if Bracanat 150mg Tablet and alcohol are compatible. Please seek medical advice.

#### Pregnancy -SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

#### SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

There is no information available on the use of Bracanat 150mg Tablet during pregnancy. Please seek
medical advice.

#### Breast feeding - UNSAFE

There is no information available on the use of Bracanat 150mg Tablet during Breast feeding. Please
seek medical advice.

#### Driving - SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

The effect of Bracanat 150mg Tablet on driving abilities is unknown. If you're experiencing symptoms
that make it hard for you to focus or respond, you should refrain from driving.

#### Kidney–SAFE IF PRESCRIBED

The data is unavailable. Prior to taking any medication, please seek medical advice.

#### Liver – CAUTION

The data is unavailable. Prior to taking any medication, please seek medical advice.

#### Tips

It is best to take it with food and at the same time each day.

You should skip the missed dose and continue on your regular schedule if you forget to take your
medication or vomit. It is not recommended to take two doses of the medication at the same time.

While using this medication, use an effective method of contraception to avoid getting pregnant.

It could make you dizzy. Until you know how it affects you, you shouldn't do anything that requires
concentration, like driving.

Whether you are pregnant, trying to get pregnant, or already breastfeeding, it is important to let
your doctor know.

Do not discontinue use of the medication without first consulting your doctor.

# Emtaf-B Tablet

Molecular Salt: [Tenofovir Alafenamide (25mg)][9]

Emtaf-B Tablet is administered to patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection and HIV
infection. It inhibits the proliferation of viruses in human cells. This procedure prevents the
virus from generating new viruses and resolves your infection.

Consult your physician regarding the appropriate dosage and duration for Emtaf-B Tablet. Please
ensure that you complete the entire course of treatment, regardless of whether you are feeling
better. Do not skip any dosage. It is recommended to consume the medication with sustenance to
enhance its absorption into the body. It is crucial to continue their use until your physician
determines that it is safe to discontinue.

This medication often causes the following unwanted effects: nausea, vomiting, diarrhea,
indigestion, stomach discomfort, joint pain, and headaches. If these effects last for more than a
few days, you should see a doctor. These are normally not a cause for concern, but it's important to
inform your doctor if they cause you distress or persist. Skin reactions or liver damage are very
rare side effects. Your doctor will keep an eye out for these when you're first starting therapy.

It is recommended to consult your physician before use if you have a history of skin conditions,
liver illness, or kidney disease. You may require frequent blood tests to monitor your liver
function and blood counts while taking it. You should stay away from alcohol because it can harm
your liver. Before utilizing this medication, pregnant or breastfeeding mothers should consult their
physician. It is important to avoid sharing personal goods such as razors or toothbrushes if you are
HIV positive, and to never have intercourse without protection. To learn more about safe methods,
such as condoms, to avoid contracting HIV during sexual activity, consult your doctor.

#### Indication
* Treatment of Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection

#### Benefits

In the Treatment of Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection

Severe liver infection caused by the chronic hepatitis B virus, which persists for at least six
months without resolution, is known as chronic hepatitis. An effective treatment for this illness is
the Emtaf-B Tablet. It enhances quality of life while decreasing the likelihood of consequences like
new infections. Failure to treat this infection can result in serious liver damage, which in turn
can cause additional serious health complications or even death.

#### Side effects

Most side effects don't need to be treated by a doctor, and they go away as your body adapts to the
medicine. You should consult your doctor if the symptoms continue or if you are concerned.

#### Common side effects of Emtaf-B Tablet
* Headache
* Diarrhea
* Nausea
* Fatigue
* Abdominal pain
* Cough
* Back pain
* Indigestion
* Joint pain

#### How to use

Take this medication as prescribed by your doctor in the dosage and time frame specified. Take it
all in at once. Avoid chewing, crushing, or breaking it in any way. It is best to take Emtaf-B
Tablet at the same time each day, with the meal.

#### How it works

Emtaf-B Tablet is a medicine that eliminates viruses. It stops the virus from replicating in human
cells. In addition to curing your infection, this also prevents the virus from replicating.

#### Precautions

#### Alcohol – UNSAFE

It's not known if Emtaf-B Tablet and alcohol are compatible. Please seek medical advice.

#### Pregnancy -SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

It is believed that Emtaf-B Tablet is safe to take during pregnancy. However, there is a lack of
human research despite evidence of minimal or no harm to the foetus from those conducted on animals.

#### Breastfeeding - UNSAFE

It's likely safe to take Emtaf-B Tablet during breastfeeding. There is not enough information about
the drug's effects on humans to determine if it poses a serious risk to the unborn child.

#### Driving - SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

Emtaf-B Tablet may impair alertness, impair eyesight, or make you sleepy and dizzy while driving. If
these symptoms appear, do not drive.

#### Kidney - SAFE IF PRESCRIBED

In patients with severe kidney disease, Emtaf-B Tablet should be taken with caution. The Emtaf-B
Tablet dosage may need to be adjusted. Please seek medical advice.

#### Liver – CAUTION

Patients with liver conditions can safely take Emtaf-B Tablet. In these patients, it may not be
necessary to change the dosage of Emtaf-B Tablet, however, there is very limited data to support
this. Please seek medical advice.

#### Tips

Patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection are given Emtaf-B Tablet.

The treatment of HIV infections involves the use of this drug in conjunction with others.

The drug will be absorbed more fully into the body if taken with food.

Emtaf-B Tablet may make you drowsy or dizzy. Until you know how it affects you, do not drive or do
anything that requires attention.

It is still possible for you to have infections or other viral-related disorders while taking this
medicine.

Spreading HIV or HBV is another possibility. Never share a needle or anything else that could
potentially come into contact with blood or other bodily fluids.

Blood tests are necessary to monitor your liver function, hepatitis B virus level, and blood cell
count during treatment and for at least six months after quitting this medication.

It is important to take the missed dose of Emtaf-B Tablet without delay. Nevertheless, if your next
dose is approaching, you should not take the missed dose and return to your usual schedule. Do not
take two doses at once.

# Duovir Tablet

Molecular Salt: [Lamivudine (150mg) + Zidovudine (300mg)][9]

#### Duovir Tablet

Duovir Tablet combines two different antiretroviral medications. The human immunodeficiency virus
(HIV) is treated with this medication. It helps with the management or treatment of acquired
immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS) by boosting the immune system's ability to fight against HIV.

An individual's lifespan is improved by taking Duovir Tablet, which limits the growth of HIV in the
body and decreases the risk of having HIV-related diseases. It is permissible to administer the
medication with or without a meal. To maximize their efficacy, take these medications on a
consistent basis with one another. You should not skip doses of this medication because doing so can
delay your recovery. The treatment should be completed until your physician instructs you to
discontinue it.

Fatigue, headaches, diarrhea, and nausea are among the most prevalent adverse reactions to this
medication. In most cases, these side effects will go away on their own, but you should still tell
your doctor if they get worse or continue. It is recommended that you refrain from driving if you
experience any dizziness or drowsiness while taking this medication. Staying hydrated with plenty of
fluids will help you manage this side effect.

You should talk to your doctor before beginning therapy if you're expecting a child, nursing, or
have any kind of health issue. If your doctor is concerned about your blood pressure, kidney
function, or liver disease, he or she may recommend routine laboratory testing. It is important to
avoid sharing personal items such as razors or toothbrushes if you are HIV positive and are
breastfeeding. To learn about safe sex measures that can help you avoid contracting HIV through
sexual contact, talk to your doctor.

#### Indication
* HIV infection

#### Benefits

#### In HIV infection

HIV patients taking Duovir Tablet will experience a decrease in viral replication. It improves the
efficiency of your immune system and helps you keep the infection under control. This improves your
quality of life by reducing the likelihood of complications like new infections. It should not be
used to prevent HIV after accidental exposure because it is not a cure for HIV or AIDS. To get the
most benefit from this medication, it must be taken in accordance with your doctor's instructions
and at the dosage your medical professional has prescribed. If you take your medication as
prescribed, you can maximise the efficacy of your treatment regimen and lessen the likelihood that
your HIV infection will develop resistance to antiretroviral drugs. However, this medication will
not protect you from transmitting HIV to others.

#### Side effects

Most side effects don't need to be treated by a doctor, and they go away as your body adapts to the
medicine. You should consult your doctor if the symptoms continue or if you are concerned.

#### Common side effects of Duovir Tablet
* Headache
* Fatigue
* Cough
* Insomnia (difficulty in sleeping)
* Rash
* Joint pain
* Hair loss
* Fever
* Gastrointestinal disturbance
* Muscle disorders
* General discomfort
* Hypersensitivity
* Nausea
* Diarrhea
* Vomiting
* Loss of appetite
* Decreased appetite
* Abdominal pain
* Abdominal cramp
* Indigestion

#### How to use

Take this medication as prescribed by your doctor in the dosage and time frame specified. Take it
all in at once. Avoid chewing, crushing or breaking it in any way. It is best to take Duovir Tablet
at the same time each day, with or without meal.

#### How it works

Both Lamivudine and Zidovudine, which are effective against HIV, are present in the Duovir Tablet.
The amount of HIV (virus) in your body will decrease because the stops the virus from replicating.
In addition, they raise the quantity of protective white blood cells called CD4s in the body.

#### Precautions

#### Alcohol – UNSAFE

Alcohol consumption is not recommended when using Duovir Tablet. Please seek medical advice.

#### Pregnancy -SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

It's possible that using Duovir Tablet while pregnant is dangerous. Animal research have
demonstrated negative effects on the developing foetus, despite the fact that human studies are
scarce. When your doctor prescribes it to you, he or she will consider the benefits and hazards.
Please seek medical advice.

#### Breast feeding - UNSAFE

It's likely safe to take Duovir Tablet during breastfeeding. There is not enough information about
the drug's effects on humans to determine if it poses a serious risk to the unborn child.

#### Driving - SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

Duovir Tablet may impair alertness, impair eyesight, or make you sleepy and dizzy while driving. If
these symptoms appear, do not drive.

#### Kidney - SAFE IF PRESCRIBED

In patients with kidney disease, Duovir Tablet should be taken with caution. Duovir Tablet dosage
may need to be adjusted. Please seek medical advice.

#### Liver – CAUTION

Patients with liver problems should use Duovir Tablet with caution. A change in the dosage of Duovir
Tablet is possible. Please seek medical advice.

Patients with moderate to severe liver illness should avoid taking Duovir Tablet.

#### Tips

Duovir Tablet is a combination of two medications that restrict or halt the progression of HIV
infections.

Start taking it no later than 72 hours after being exposed to HIV if you want to use it for HIV
prevention as well.

The drug will be absorbed more fully into the body if taken with food.

Duovir Tablets may make you drowsy or dizzy. Until you know how it affects you, do not drive or do
anything that requires attention.

There is a higher probability of treatment failure if dosages are skipped. It is imperative that you
adhere to the prescribed dosing schedule.

While utilizing Duovir Tablet, it is imperative to adhere to secure sexual practices. Please refrain
from sharing personal items or syringes that may contain blood or bodily fluids.

Your bones may become weakened as a result. Exercise consistently and adhere to your physician's
recommendations for calcium and vitamin D supplements.

It is important to take the missed dose of Duovir Tablet without delay. Nevertheless, if your next
dose is approaching, you should not take the missed dose and return to your usual schedule. Do not
take two doses at once.

# Cellcept 500mg Tablet

Molecular Salt: [Mycophenolate Mofetil][9]

#### Cellcept 500mg Tablet

Immunosuppressants are the class of medications that Cellcept 500mg Tablet belongs to. With other
medications, it is used to prevent your body from rejecting a new organ (such as a liver, kidney, or
heart) after transplant. So it weakens your body's immune system so that the new organ is not
attacked.

How much Cellcept 500mg Tablet you take and how often you take it depends on the type of transplant.
Take your doctor's advice very seriously. At least an hour before or two hours after a meal, you
should take it on an empty stomach to get the most benefit. Avoid chewing, crushing or breaking it
in any way. Even if you are feeling better, it is important to continue taking this medication
consistently in order to get the full benefits. In order to avoid rejection, the treatment will be
continued for as long as you require.

The most common side effects include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, headache, high blood
pressure, and changes in white blood cell count. As a result, you may be more susceptible to
infections than usual. As a result, some cancers are more likely to develop. Use sunscreen and limit
your time in the sun to reduce your risk of developing skin cancer. There are many possible side
effects. Because some of them are serious and require immediate medical attention, you should
consult your doctor about them.

You should not take this medication if you are expecting a child, trying to conceive, or
breastfeeding a baby. If you have any signs of infection, bruising, or bleeding, or if you've ever
had an issue with your digestive system, you should consult your doctor before taking this
medication. If you are taking any other medications, your doctor needs to know about them because
they may interact with this medication and alter its effectiveness. The number of your blood cells
and the amount of sugar and cholesterol in your blood will be monitored regularly.

#### Indication
* • Prevention of organ rejection in transplant patients

#### Benefits

In the Prevention of organ rejection in transplant patients

Cellcept 500mg Tablet belongs to a class of drugs known as immunosuppressants. This medication
minimizes the likelihood of your body attacking the donated organ by weakening your immune response.
When your immune system sees a new organ as an intruder and attacks it, it's called organ rejection.
This medication can be used in conjunction with others to suppress the immune system and support in
the body's acceptance of the new organ.

#### Side effects

Most side effects don't need to be treated by a doctor, and they go away as your body adapts to the
medicine. You should consult your doctor if the symptoms continue or if you are concerned.

#### Common side effects of Cellcept 500mg Tablet
* • Nausea
* • Vomiting
* • Diarrhea
* • Abdominal pain
* • Headache
* • High blood pressure
* • Decreased white blood cell count (neutrophils)

#### How to use

Take this medication as prescribed by your doctor in the dosage and time frame specified. It is best
to take Cellcept 500mg Tablet at the same time each day, with or without meal.

#### How it works

Cellcept 500mg Tablet is an immunosuppressive drug. Rejection of a transplanted organ is prevented
by reducing the activity of the body's own defense mechanism (the immune system).

#### Precautions

#### Alcohol – UNSAFE

Drinking alcohol while taking Cellcept 500mg Tablet has no negative effects.

#### Pregnancy -SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

Cellcept 500mg Tablet is unsafe for Pregnant women, as there is clear evidence of harm to the
unborn. However, if the advantages outweigh the potential hazards, the doctor may prescribe it in
specific life-threatening cases. Please seek medical advice.

#### Breastfeeding - UNSAFE

It is not recommended to take Cellcept 500mg Tablet while lactating. The medicine may be hazardous
to the baby, according to data.

#### Driving - SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

Cellcept 500mg Tablet generally does not impair your ability to drive.

#### Kidney - SAFE IF PRESCRIBED

Patients with a kidney condition can safely take Cellcept 500mg Tablet. There is no need to modify
the dosage of Cellcept 500mg Tablet. Please seek medical advice.

#### Liver – CAUTION

Limited data is available on the efficacy of Cellcept 500mg Tablet for patients with liver disease.
Please seek medical advice.

#### Tips

Cellcept 500mg Tablet is prescribed by your doctor to prevent your body from rejecting an organ
transplant (e.g. kidney, heart, or liver).

The medication may take 6 to 12 weeks to work. Continue to take it as directed.

Birth control is necessary for women of childbearing age because it may cause birth abnormalities.

As a result, you are more prone to developing infections. Avoid contact with infected individuals.
Sore throat, fever, or any other symptoms of infection should be treated as soon as possible by
seeing your doctor.

Wear protective clothing and apply sunscreen with a high sun protection factor (SPF) to protect
yourself from direct sunlight.

Take it with a meal to lessen the risk of nausea and stomach pain, which can be side effects of this
medication.

Your blood cell count may be monitored by your doctor on a regular basis using blood tests. If you
see unexplained bruising or bleeding, a sore throat, oral ulcers, a fever, or any other symptoms,
consult your doctor.
