# CYCOKAST-50 Injection

Molecular Salt: [Cisplatin (50mg)][9]

#### CYCOKAST-50 Injection

CYCOKAST-50 Injection is a prescription drug that is used to treat ovarian, cervical, and testicular
cancers. It works by reducing or preventing the proliferation of cancer cells in the body.

A qualified medical practitioner administers CYCOKAST-50 Injection as an injection into the vein.
Your doctor will determine the dosage and frequency of your medication. Depending on the condition
you're being treated for, this may vary from time to time. Take it exactly as directed by your
doctor as taking it in the wrong manner or overdosing on it can result in side effects. Do not stop
taking it until your doctor instructs you to do so as It may take several weeks or months before you
see or experience any improvement.

This medicine's common adverse effects include injection site reaction (pain, swelling, redness),
nausea, and vomiting. Because hearing issues or ear damage are a major adverse effect of this
medicine, your doctor can prescribe a hearing test both before and after you start taking it. Blood
cell counts (both red and white) may be lowered as a result of taking this medication, making you
more vulnerable to infections. In order to monitor your blood cells, heart, liver, and kidney
function, you need to have regular blood tests.

If you have or have ever had kidney disease, tell your doctor before taking this medication, as it
can impair the kidney's ability to work. If you are taking any other medications, make sure your
healthcare team is aware of them, since they may interact with or impact this medication. A pregnant
or breastfeeding woman should avoid using this medication. Men should obtain medical guidance about
sperm freezing before initiating treatment because it has the potential to induce infertility.

#### Indication
* Ovarian cancer
* Cervical cancer
* Testicular cancer

#### Benefits

#### In Ovarian cancer

In women, ovarian cancer develops in the ovaries, which generate the female reproductive system's
eggs (ovaries). This form of cancer is often discovered far too late and is often fatal.
Predominantly, it is seen in the pelvis and the stomach. A cancer cell's growth is eliminated or
inhibited by CYCOKAST-50 Injection, which also prevents the proliferation of cancer cells. Despite
its effectiveness, there are some negative effects to consider. The best thing you can do to avoid
these adverse effects is to consult your doctor. Keep yourself hydrated by consuming plenty of water
and avoiding alcohol while undergoing this therapy.

#### In Cervical cancer

Anti-cancer drug CYCOKAST-50 Injection is used to eliminate malignant cells in cervical cancer, a
cancer that develops in the cervix of a female. Women who are infected may experience symptoms such
as abnormal bleeding, smelly vaginal discharge, and pain in the lower back, or may even have no
symptoms at all. Despite its effectiveness, there are some negative effects to consider. The best
thing you can do to avoid these adverse effects is to consult your doctor. Keep yourself hydrated by
consuming plenty of water and avoiding alcohol while undergoing this therapy.

#### In Testicular cancer

Testicular cancer is a type of cancer that affects the testicles, which produce male hormones and
sperm. The testicles are positioned beneath the penis in a loose bag of skin called the scrotum.
50mg Celplat Injection eliminates or stops the growth of cancer cells in men, as well as inhibiting
their proliferation. It is administered by a doctor or nurse as an injection and should not be
self-administered.

#### Side effects

Most side effects don't need to be treated by a doctor, and they go away as your body adapts to the
medicine. You should consult your doctor if the symptoms continue or if you are concerned.

#### Common side effects of CYCOKAST-50 Injection
* Injection site reactions (pain, swelling, redness)
* Increased risk of infection
* Ear disorder
* Vomiting
* Nausea
* Decreased blood cells (red cells, white cells, and platelets)
* Renal impairment
* Peripheral neuropathy (tingling and numbness of feet and hand)
* Kidney damage
* Hearing loss
* Ringing in ear

#### How to use

Your doctor or nurse will give you this medication. Do not administer yourself.

#### How it works

CYCOKAST-50 Injection is a cancer-fighting drug. It acts by destroying the cancer cells' genetic
material (DNA and RNA), inhibiting their growth and proliferation.

#### Precautions

#### Alcohol – UNSAFE

It's not known if CYCOKAST-50 Injection and alcohol are compatible. Please seek medical advice.

#### Pregnancy -SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

CYCOKAST-50 Injection is unsafe for Pregnant women, as there is clear evidence of harm to the
unborn. However, if the advantages outweigh the potential hazards, the doctor may prescribe it in
specific life-threatening cases. Please seek medical advice.

#### Breast feeding - UNSAFE

It is not recommended to take CYCOKAST-50 Injection while lactating. The medicine may be hazardous
to the baby, according to data.

#### Driving - SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

CYCOKAST-50 Injection may have negative effects that impair your driving skills.

CYCOKAST-50 Injection has the potential to cause side effects such as sleepiness and vomiting, which
could impair your driving abilities.

#### Kidney - SAFE IF PRESCRIBED

In patients with kidney disease, CYCOKAST-50 Injection should be taken with caution. CYCOKAST-50
Injection dosage may need to be adjusted. Please seek medical advice

Patients with a serious kidney condition should avoid taking CYCOKAST-50 Injection.

#### Liver – CAUTION

Patients with liver conditions can safely take CYCOKAST-50 Injection. There is no need to modify the
dosage of CYCOKAST-50 Injection. Please seek medical advice.

#### Tips

CYCOKAST-50 Injection is administered under the supervision of a doctor.

Consult your doctor if you miss a dose of CYCOKAST-50 Injection.

# Afanat 40mg Tablet

Molecular Salt: [Afatinib dimaleate][9]

#### Afanat 40mg Tablet

Patients with non-small cell lung cancer are given Afanat 40mg Tablet. It serves to treat adult
patients who possess specific mutations of the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR).

The best results will come from taking Afanat 40mg Tablet on an empty stomach at the same time each
day. The dosage and frequency of consumption will be determined by your physician. This will depend
on the condition you are being treated for and could change sometimes. Follow the doctor's
instructions for dosage carefully. Side effects from taking it incorrectly or in excess might be
quite harmful. Take it consistently until your physician instructs you to discontinue, regardless of
whether you experience any consequences for several weeks or months.

Nausea, diarrhoea, rash, and dry skin comprise the most prevalent adverse effects of this
medication. Diarrhoea can be severe at times; therefore, it is important to adhere to the doctor's
prescription for medication or maintain hydration. While you are taking this medication, your
physician may recommend that you undergo certain blood tests. It is also possible that it will
increase your skin's sensitivity to the sun. Therefore, it is advisable to use sunscreen and wear
protective garments when exposed to sunlight. Please notify your physician if you experience eye
irritation, redness, or dryness.

If you are currently taking any medications to treat infections, have a liver or kidney condition,
or have a respiratory problem, inform your doctor before taking this medication. Many other
medications can either affect or be affected by this medication. Therefore, it is important to
inform your healthcare team of all medications you are currently taking. During pregnancy and
lactation, this medication is not advised. Females must utilise effective contraception during
treatment in order to prevent pregnancy.

#### Indication
* Non-small cell lung cancer

#### Benefits

#### In Non-small cell lung cancer

Non-small cell lung cancer is a significant form of lung cancer that impacts both smokers and
non-smokers. Afanat 40mg Tablet is a medication that is used to treat non-small cell lung cancer and
can be administered either alone or in conjunction with other medications. It is an extremely toxic
and potent medication, and it is advisable to consult with your physician regarding the potential
advantages and disadvantages. It is recommended that you refrain from consuming alcohol during this
treatment and consume an adequate amount of water to maintain your hydration.

#### Side effects

Most side effects don't need to be treated by a doctor, and they go away as your body adapts to the
medicine. You should consult your doctor if the symptoms continue or if you are concerned.

#### Common side effects of Afanat 40mg Tablet
* Diarrhea
* Rash
* Dry skin
* Nausea
* Vomiting
* Loss of appetite
* Itching
* Stomatitis (Inflammation of the mouth)
* Nail disorder

#### How to use

Take this medication as prescribed by your doctor in the dosage and time frame specified. Take it
all in at once. Avoid chewing, crushing or breaking it in any way. It is best to take Afanat 40mg
Tablet at the same time each day, without a meal.

#### How it works

Afanat 40mg Tablet is an anticancer medication. It functions by binding to and inhibiting the enzyme
receptors (EGFR, HER2, and HER4) that are responsible for the proliferation of cancer cells.
Consequently, this leads to the downregulation of signalling pathways. This is the method of
preventing or delaying the progression of malignancy.

#### Precautions

#### Alcohol – UNSAFE

Alcohol consumption in conjunction with Afanat 40mg Tablet does not result in any adverse effects.

#### Pregnancy -SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

Afanat 40mg Tablet is unsafe for Pregnant women, as there is clear evidence of harm to the unborn.
However, if the advantages outweigh the potential hazards, the doctor may prescribe it in specific
life-threatening cases. Please seek medical advice.

#### Breastfeeding - UNSAFE

Use of Afanat 40mg Tablet while breast-feeding is most likely harmful to the infant. The medicine
may enter the breast milk and harm the baby, according to a minimal amount of human data.

#### Driving - SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

The effect of Afanat 40mg Tablet on driving abilities is unknown. If you're experiencing symptoms
that make it hard for you to focus or respond, you should refrain from driving.

#### Kidney - SAFE IF PRESCRIBED

Patients with a kidney condition can safely take Afanat 40mg tablets. In these patients, it may not
be necessary to change the dosage of Afanat 40mg Tablet, however, there is very limited data to
support this. Please seek medical advice.

#### Liver – CAUTION

Patients with liver conditions can safely take Afanat 40mg tablets. In these patients, it may not be
necessary to change the dosage of Afanat 40mg Tablet, however, there is very limited data to support
this. Please seek medical advice.

#### Tips

Patients with non-small cell lung cancer are given Afanat 40mg Tablet.

For optimal results, take the Afanat 40mg Tablet without food, either one hour before or two hours
after a meal.

Afanat 40mg Tablet often causes mild to severe diarrhoea. To alleviate diarrhoea, your doctor could
recommend medication. Take this medication precisely as prescribed while staying hydrated.

Sun sensitivity is a side effect of Afanat 40mg Tablet. Keep your sun exposure to a minimum. Wear
protective clothing and use sunscreen if you must be outside in the sun.

Acne, rash, and erythema may result from the use of Afanat 40mg Tablet. Immediately seek treatment
for skin reactions upon noticing them.

While using this medication and for the first 30 days after stopping, use a reliable method of birth
control to avoid becoming pregnant.

While taking this medication, it is important to regularly monitor your blood pressure. If you
experience symptoms of extremely high blood pressure, including severe headaches, confusion, visual
impairments, vertigo, or vomiting, please notify your physician.

This medication should not be used by women who are pregnant, trying to conceive, or nursing.

If you miss taking Afanat 40mg Tablet, skip the missed one and return to your regular schedule
instead. It is not recommended to take two doses of the medication at the same time.

# Afanat 30mg Tablet

Molecular Salt: [Afatinib dimaleate][9]

#### Afanat 30mg Tablet

Patients with non-small cell lung cancer are given Afanat 30mg Tablet. It serves to treat adult
patients who possess specific mutations of the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR).

The best results will come from taking Afanat 30mg Tablet on an empty stomach at the same time each
day. The dosage and frequency of consumption will be determined by your physician. This will depend
on the condition you are being treated for and could alter sometimes. Follow the doctor's
instructions for dosage carefully. Side effects from taking it incorrectly or in excess might be
quite harmful. Take it consistently until your physician instructs you to discontinue, regardless of
whether you experience any consequences for several weeks or months.

Nausea, diarrhoea, rash, and dry skin comprise the most prevalent adverse effects of this
medication. Diarrhoea can be severe at times; therefore, it is important to adhere to the doctor's
prescription for medication or maintain hydration. While you are taking this medication, your
physician may recommend that you undergo certain blood tests. It is also possible that it will
increase your skin's sensitivity to the sun. Therefore, it is advisable to use sunscreen and wear
protective garments when exposed to sunlight. Please notify your physician if you experience eye
irritation, redness, or dryness.

If you are currently taking any medications to treat infections, have a liver or kidney condition,
or have a respiratory problem, inform your doctor before taking this medication. Many other
medications can either affect or be affected by this medication. Therefore, it is important to
inform your healthcare team of all medications you are currently taking. During pregnancy and
lactation, this medication is not advised. It is crucial for females to utilise effective
contraception during treatment in order to prevent pregnancy.

#### Indication
* Non-small cell lung cancer

#### Benefits

#### In Non-small cell lung cancer

Non-small cell lung cancer is a significant form of lung cancer that impacts both smokers and
non-smokers. Afanat 30mg Tablet is a medication that is used to treat non-small cell lung cancer and
can be administered either alone or in conjunction with other medications. It is an extremely toxic
and potent medication, and it is advisable to consult with your physician regarding the potential
advantages and disadvantages. It is recommended that you refrain from consuming alcohol during the
course of this treatment and consume an adequate amount of water to maintain your hydration.

#### Side effects

Most side effects don't need to be treated by a doctor, and they go away as your body adapts to the
medicine. You should consult your doctor if the symptoms continue or if you are concerned.

#### Common side effects of Afanat 30mg Tablet
* Diarrhea
* Rash
* Dry skin
* Nausea
* Vomiting
* Loss of appetite
* Itching
* Stomatitis (Inflammation of the mouth)
* Nail disorder

#### How to use

Take this medication as prescribed by your doctor in the dosage and time frame specified. Take it
all in at once. Avoid chewing, crushing or breaking it in any way. It is best to take Afanat 30mg
Tablet at the same time each day, without meal.

#### How it works

Afanat 30mg Tablet is an anticancer medication. It functions by binding to and inhibiting the enzyme
receptors (EGFR, HER2, and HER4) that are responsible for the proliferation of cancer cells.
Consequently, this leads to the downregulation of signalling pathways. This is the method of
preventing or delaying the progression of malignancy.

#### Precautions

#### Alcohol – UNSAFE

Alcohol consumption in conjunction with Afanat 30mg Tablet does not result in any adverse effects.

#### Pregnancy -SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

Afanat 30mg Tablet is unsafe for Pregnant women, as there is clear evidence of harm to the unborn.
However, if the advantages outweigh the potential hazards, the doctor may prescribe it in specific
life-threatening cases. Please seek medical advice.

#### Breast feeding - UNSAFE

Use of Afanat 30mg Tablet while breast-feeding is most likely harmful to the infant. The medicine
may enter into the breast milk and harm the baby, according to a minimal amount of human data.

#### Driving - SEEK THE ADVICE OF YOUR DOCTOR

The effect of Afanat 30mg Tablet on driving abilities is unknown. If you're experiencing symptoms
that make it hard for you to focus or respond, you should refrain from driving.

#### Kidney - SAFE IF PRESCRIBED

Patients with a kidney condition can safely take Afanat 30mg tablets. In these patients, it may not
be necessary to change the dosage of Afanat 30mg Tablet, however there is very limited data to
support this. Please seek medical advice.

#### Liver – CAUTION

Patients with liver conditions can safely take Afanat 30mg tablets. In these patients, it may not be
necessary to change the dosage of Afanat 30mg Tablet, however there is very limited data to support
this. Please seek medical advice.

#### Tips

Patients with non-small cell lung cancer are given Afanat 30mg Tablet.

For optimal results, take the Afanat 30mg Tablet without food, either one hour before or two hours
after a meal.

Afanat 30mg Tablet often causes mild to severe diarrhoea. To alleviate diarrhoea, your doctor could
recommend medication. Take this medication precisely as prescribed while staying hydrated.

Sun sensitivity is a side effect of Afanat 30mg Tablet. Keep your sun exposure to a minimum. Wear
protective clothing and use sunscreen if you must be outside in the sun.

Acne, rash, and erythema may result from the use of Afanat 30mg Tablet. Immediately seek treatment
for skin reactions upon noticing them.

While using this medication and for the first 30 days after stopping, use a reliable method of birth
control to avoid becoming pregnant.

While taking this medication, it is important to regularly monitor your blood pressure. If you
experience symptoms of extremely high blood pressure, including severe headaches, confusion, visual
impairments, vertigo, or vomiting, please notify your physician.

This medication should not be used by women who are pregnant, trying to conceive, or nursing.

If you miss to take Afanat 30mg Tablet, skip the missed one and return to your regular schedule
instead. It is not recommended to take two doses of the medication at the same time.

## Our Mission

Our mission is to be a trusted partner in scientific advancement by delivering world-class research
and diagnostic solutions across India. We strive to bridge global innovation with local research
needs, ensuring that every scientist, institution, and lab we serve has access to the best
technologies, responsive support, and affordable solutions — all under one roof.

## Our Vision

Our vision is to build a future where researchers always have access to trusted and dependable
tools.
We bring global-quality solutions to India with efficiency, precision, and care. Our goal is to
empower discoveries that contribute to a brighter and better tomorrow.

#### Vision & Mission

Mandate of the Centre is to provide a platform for biotechnology education, training and research at
the interface of multiple disciplines. The programmes of the Centre are designed to create
opportunities for students to engage in multidiscplinary research where they learn biotech science
while integrating engineering, medicine and science, to provide solutions for human and animal
health, agriculture and environmental technologies.

We are fully committed to upholding the highest standards of environmental responsibility, with
sustainability as our guiding compass. This commitment drives us to continuously develop innovative
solutions for the most pressing challenges facing our world.

ICL is at the forefront of the global fight against hunger, playing a critical role in enhancing
food security through its innovative agricultural solutions.  By focusing on these critical areas we
continue on our quest to develop life-saving and sustainable energy storage systems (ESS) which
improve people’s lives.

all_classified.polished_summary: Impriindia is a New Delhi-based startup research think tank dedicated to proactive, independent, and policy-oriented research. It offers a range of services, including fellowships and courses aimed at enhancing knowledge in public policy, as well as conducting thematic research for government agencies, NGOs, and academic institutions. Additionally, Impriindia publishes books, reports, and articles to inform researchers, policymakers, and the general public on critical public policy issues.

all_classified.company_summary: Incyte is a global pharmaceutical company dedicated to developing innovative therapies in the fields of hematology, oncology, and inflammation. With a robust portfolio of products and partnered programs, Incyte focuses on addressing significant medical challenges and improving patient outcomes through scientific advancements. The company is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture while delivering transformative solutions to healthcare providers and patients worldwide.

in Hematology, Oncology and Inflammation and Autoimmunity, we are committed to developing and
delivering innovative medicines for patients.

Medication Profiles

Comprehensive information about pharmaceutical compounds with evidence-based data

Valtrex
Antiviral

Valtrex (Valacyclovir) is an antiviral medication primarily used to treat herpes simplex virus infections, including genital herpes, cold sores, and shingles. As a prodrug of acyclovir, it offers improved bioavailability and convenient dosing schedules.

Uses

Herpes simplex virus (HSV-1 and HSV-2)

Varicella-zoster virus (shingles)

Prevention of cytomegalovirus infection

Side Effects

Headache and nausea

Abdominal pain

Dizziness (rare)

Warnings & Precautions

Kidney function monitoring required

Adequate hydration essential

Dose adjustment in renal impairment

Drug Interactions

Probenecid (increases valacyclovir levels)

Nephrotoxic drugs

Cimetidine

Clinical Studies Available
Treatment Guidelines

Zovirax
Antiviral

Zovirax ( Acyclovir ) is a nucleoside analog antiviral medication that inhibits viral DNA synthesis. It's considered the gold standard for treating herpes virus infections and has been extensively studied since its introduction in the 1980s.

Uses

Herpes simplex encephalitis

Neonatal herpes infections

Varicella in immunocompromised patients

Side Effects

Injection site reactions (IV form)

Neurological effects (high doses)

Gastrointestinal disturbances

Warnings & Precautions

Monitor renal function closely

Slow IV infusion required

Pregnancy category B

Drug Interactions

Probenecid (prolongs half-life)

Zidovudine (increased neurotoxicity)

Mycophenolate mofetil

Clinical Studies Available
Treatment Guidelines

Diltiazem
Calcium Channel Blocker

Diltiazem is a non-dihydropyridine calcium channel blocker used primarily for hypertension and angina. It works by blocking calcium channels in cardiac and smooth muscle, reducing heart rate and blood pressure while improving coronary blood flow.

Uses

Essential hypertension

Chronic stable angina

Atrial fibrillation rate control

Side Effects

Peripheral edema

Bradycardia

Constipation

Warnings & Precautions

Avoid in heart failure

Monitor liver function

Gradual discontinuation required

Drug Interactions

Beta-blockers (additive effects)

Digoxin (increased levels)

Statins (increased myopathy risk)

Clinical Studies Available
Treatment Guidelines

Starlix
Antidiabetic

Starlix (Nateglinide) is a meglitinide analog used for postprandial glucose control in type 2 diabetes. It stimulates insulin release from pancreatic beta cells in a glucose-dependent manner, making it effective for controlling post-meal blood sugar spikes.

Uses

Type 2 diabetes mellitus

Postprandial hyperglycemia

Combination therapy with metformin

Side Effects

Hypoglycemia

Upper respiratory infections

Weight gain

Warnings & Precautions

Monitor blood glucose regularly

Take before meals

Avoid in hepatic impairment

Drug Interactions

NSAIDs (increased hypoglycemia risk)

Beta-blockers (mask hypoglycemia)

Corticosteroids (antagonistic effects)

Clinical Studies Available
Treatment Guidelines

Nemasole
Antiparasitic

Nemasole (Albendazole) is a broad-spectrum antiparasitic medication belonging to the benzimidazole class. It's highly effective against various helminth infections and is considered essential medicine by the World Health Organization for treating neglected tropical diseases.

Uses

Hydatid disease (echinococcosis)

Neurocysticercosis

Ascariasis and hookworm infections

Side Effects

Abdominal pain

Headache and dizziness

Elevated liver enzymes

Warnings & Precautions

Monitor liver function tests

Contraindicated in pregnancy

Complete blood count monitoring

Drug Interactions

Dexamethasone (increases albendazole levels)

Praziquantel (synergistic effects)

Cimetidine (increased bioavailability)

Clinical Studies Available
Treatment Guidelines

Vermox
Anthelmintic

Vermox (Mebendazole) is a benzimidazole anthelmintic medication used to treat various intestinal worm infections. It works by inhibiting microtubule synthesis in parasites, leading to their death and elimination from the gastrointestinal tract.

Uses

Pinworm infections (enterobiasis)

Roundworm infections (ascariasis)

Whipworm infections (trichuriasis)

Side Effects

Gastrointestinal upset

Transient abdominal pain

Rare allergic reactions

Warnings & Precautions

Not recommended in pregnancy

Take with food for better absorption

Family members may need treatment

Drug Interactions

Carbamazepine (reduced mebendazole levels)

Phenytoin (decreased efficacy)

Metronidazole (potential interactions)

Clinical Studies Available
Treatment Guidelines

Furosemide
Loop Diuretic

Furosemide is a potent loop diuretic that inhibits sodium-potassium-chloride co-transporter in the ascending limb of the loop of Henle. It's widely used for treating edema associated with heart failure, liver disease, and renal disease, as well as hypertension.

Uses

Congestive heart failure

Pulmonary edema

Hypertension management

Side Effects

Electrolyte imbalances

Dehydration

Ototoxicity (high doses)

Warnings & Precautions

Monitor electrolytes regularly

Assess kidney function

Avoid excessive diuresis

Drug Interactions

Digoxin (increased toxicity risk)

Lithium (increased levels)

NSAIDs (reduced diuretic effect)

Clinical Studies Available
Treatment Guidelines

InfoAntiviral was founded with a clear goal: to deliver accurate, transparent, and up-to-date
medical information about antiviral drugs and infectious disease therapies for global audiences.
Every page on this site is built around scientific evidence, verified data, and editorial integrity.

## Our Mission and Vision

The mission of InfoAntiviral is to empower patients, healthcare professionals, and researchers with
reliable and accessible antiviral drug information. We focus on bridging the gap between complex
pharmacological data and real-world understanding. Our commitment is to provide clarity, safety, and
accuracy in every article.

Our vision is to create a trusted digital reference for antiviral medications - one that balances
scientific rigor with plain-language explanations, ensuring that readers can make informed health
decisions in consultation with medical professionals.

## Editorial Values and Independence

Editorial independence is a core principle at InfoAntiviral. We do not accept payments for drug
placement, ranking, or visibility. Our content is written and reviewed by professionals with
expertise in pharmacology, virology, and clinical medicine. Each article undergoes a structured
process of writing, medical verification, and editorial review before publication.
* **Accuracy:** Each statement is supported by verifiable data from trusted sources such as the FDA,
EMA, WHO, and peer-reviewed journals.
* **Transparency:** Sources and references are openly cited in every article.
* **Accountability:** We correct any factual inaccuracies promptly upon verification.

## Our Expertise

InfoAntiviral`s editorial team includes medical writers, pharmacists, and scientific editors with
experience in infectious diseases, public health, and pharmaceutical research. Our contributors have
worked in both clinical and academic settings, ensuring that every article reflects real-world
relevance and scientific credibility.

Medical reviewers include licensed pharmacists (PharmD, MScPharm), infectious disease physicians
(MD, MPH), and pharmacovigilance experts. Their combined insight ensures the balance between
accuracy and readability.

## Our Editorial and Review Process

Every article on InfoAntiviral follows a transparent workflow designed to maintain quality and
consistency:
1. **Research:** Authors gather data from primary regulatory sources (FDA labels, EMA documents,
PubMed studies) and trusted medical guidelines.
2. **Drafting:** Medical writers produce clear, patient-friendly summaries of complex topics without
altering scientific meaning.
3. **Review:** The draft is medically reviewed by a subject matter expert to ensure factual
correctness and clinical accuracy.
4. **Copyediting:** Editors review grammar, readability, and SEO compliance while maintaining
professional tone.
5. **Verification:** Citations are rechecked against source documents to confirm authenticity.
6. **Publication:** Articles are updated periodically to reflect new evidence or regulatory changes.

## Transparency and Ethical Standards

We adhere to strict transparency and disclosure principles. When available, conflicts of interest
are declared, and no external entity influences our editorial direction. We avoid promotional
content and disclaim all forms of pharmaceutical sponsorship unless explicitly labeled.

All medical information provided on this site is for educational purposes only and does not replace
professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Readers should always consult qualified
healthcare providers before making clinical decisions.

# About InfoAntiviral

**Last updated:** October 2025
**Reviewed by:** InfoAntiviral Editorial Board

InfoAntiviral was founded with a clear goal: to deliver accurate, transparent, and up-to-date
medical information about antiviral drugs and infectious disease therapies for global audiences.
Every page on this site is built around scientific evidence, verified data, and editorial integrity.

## Our Mission and Vision

The mission of InfoAntiviral is to empower patients, healthcare professionals, and researchers with
reliable and accessible antiviral drug information. We focus on bridging the gap between complex
pharmacological data and real-world understanding. Our commitment is to provide clarity, safety, and
accuracy in every article.

Our vision is to create a trusted digital reference for antiviral medications - one that balances
scientific rigor with plain-language explanations, ensuring that readers can make informed health
decisions in consultation with medical professionals.

## Editorial Values and Independence

Editorial independence is a core principle at InfoAntiviral. We do not accept payments for drug
placement, ranking, or visibility. Our content is written and reviewed by professionals with
expertise in pharmacology, virology, and clinical medicine. Each article undergoes a structured
process of writing, medical verification, and editorial review before publication.
* **Accuracy:** Each statement is supported by verifiable data from trusted sources such as the FDA,
EMA, WHO, and peer-reviewed journals.
* **Transparency:** Sources and references are openly cited in every article.
* **Accountability:** We correct any factual inaccuracies promptly upon verification.

## Our Expertise

InfoAntiviral`s editorial team includes medical writers, pharmacists, and scientific editors with
experience in infectious diseases, public health, and pharmaceutical research. Our contributors have
worked in both clinical and academic settings, ensuring that every article reflects real-world
relevance and scientific credibility.

Medical reviewers include licensed pharmacists (PharmD, MScPharm), infectious disease physicians
(MD, MPH), and pharmacovigilance experts. Their combined insight ensures the balance between
accuracy and readability.

## Our Editorial and Review Process

Every article on InfoAntiviral follows a transparent workflow designed to maintain quality and
consistency:
1. **Research:** Authors gather data from primary regulatory sources (FDA labels, EMA documents,
PubMed studies) and trusted medical guidelines.
2. **Drafting:** Medical writers produce clear, patient-friendly summaries of complex topics without
altering scientific meaning.
3. **Review:** The draft is medically reviewed by a subject matter expert to ensure factual
correctness and clinical accuracy.
4. **Copyediting:** Editors review grammar, readability, and SEO compliance while maintaining
professional tone.
5. **Verification:** Citations are rechecked against source documents to confirm authenticity.
6. **Publication:** Articles are updated periodically to reflect new evidence or regulatory changes.

## Transparency and Ethical Standards

We adhere to strict transparency and disclosure principles. When available, conflicts of interest
are declared, and no external entity influences our editorial direction. We avoid promotional
content and disclaim all forms of pharmaceutical sponsorship unless explicitly labeled.

All medical information provided on this site is for educational purposes only and does not replace
professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Readers should always consult qualified
healthcare providers before making clinical decisions.

## Data Sources and Referencing

Our information is compiled from reputable medical and regulatory organizations. The most frequently
referenced sources include:
* U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA)
* European Medicines Agency (EMA)
* Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
* World Health Organization (WHO)
* Peer-reviewed scientific journals indexed in PubMed and Scopus
* Clinical trial registries and published pharmacovigilance reports

Each article lists its own sources at the end of the page for user verification. InfoAntiviral
encourages readers to review the original references to enhance transparency and understanding.

## Accessibility and Language

We design content that is inclusive and easy to understand. Technical medical terms are explained in
context, and the site is optimized for accessibility on both desktop and mobile devices. Our
articles follow plain language guidelines to support comprehension among readers from different
educational backgrounds.

## Privacy and Data Ethics

InfoAntiviral does not collect personally identifiable health information. We comply with
international privacy frameworks such as GDPR and respect user confidentiality. Any analytical data
collected is used exclusively for site performance monitoring and is anonymized.

## Continuous Updates and Quality Control

Medicine evolves rapidly, especially in antiviral research. InfoAntiviral maintains an ongoing
update schedule to ensure that dosage recommendations, safety alerts, and product statuses reflect
the latest regulatory and scientific developments. Each page lists a "Last reviewed" date, and major
updates are archived for transparency.

## Contact and Feedback

We welcome professional feedback, collaboration proposals, and corrections. To contact our editorial
team, please visit the [Contact page][1]. We also encourage healthcare providers and researchers to
contribute insights or suggest topics for future publication.

About Us Section

Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST), Mohali (Punjab), an autonomous institution of the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India, has been established under the umbrella of NANO MISSION, initiated by DST to boost research and development in the field of Nanoscience and Nanotechnology in India. INST started its activities on 3rd January 2013 from its transit campus at Mohali, Punjab

## How to Reach

To reach** Institute of Nano Science and Technology, Mohali,** please use the following directions.

### From Airports:
* -

**Distance from IGI Airport Delhi :** Take a prepaid taxi (or private cabs) from the counters. Ask
for destination "Sector- 81, INST Mohali" via NH 44. The distance is about 270 km.
* -

One can also take a domestic flight from all major airport cities (like Delhi , Mumbai, Kolkata,
Bangalore etc) in India to Shaheed Bhagat Singh International Airport, Chandigarh/Mohali.
* -

**Distance from Shaheed Bhagat SIngh International Chandigarh/ Mohali Airport:** Take a prepaid
taxi (or private cabs) from the counters. Ask for destination "Sector- 81, INST Mohali" . The
distance is about 9 km.

### By Train:
* -

If you are coming from Delhi one can also take a train to Chandigarh railway station and Sahibzada
Ajeet Singh Nagar (Mohali) Railway Station.
* -

If you are coming from Chandigarh Railway Station, take a taxi for destination "Sector- 81, INST
Mohali". The distance is about 13 km.
* -

If you are coming from Mohali Railway Station, take a taxi to the destination "Sector- 81, INST
Mohali". The distance is about 5 km.

### By Road:
* -

If you are coming from Delhi via your own vehicle then you may follow NH 44 (distance is about 250
km) to Mehmadpur then Take NH 205A to Mohali Airport Chowk in Gmada Aerocity, Continue to JLPL
Industrial Area, Drive to your destination in Sector 81, Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar.
* -

For any other locations please refer to INST, Mohali in Google maps** [Click Here][68]**

About Us Section

Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST), Mohali (Punjab), an autonomous institution of the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India, has been established under the umbrella of NANO MISSION, initiated by DST to boost research and development in the field of Nanoscience and Nanotechnology in India. INST started its activities on 3rd January 2013 from its transit campus at Mohali, Punjab

# About Us

Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST), Mohali (Punjab), an autonomous institution of the
Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India, has been established under the
umbrella of NANO MISSION, initiated by DST to boost research and development in the field of
Nanoscience and Nanotechnology in India. INST started its activities on 3rd January 2013 from its
transit campus at Mohali, Punjab. In the December of 2020, the institute shifted to its
state-of-the-art new campus sprawling over 35 acres of land, at Knowledge City, Sector-81 (Mohali,
Punjab). Research activities at INST encompass physics, chemistry, biology, and interdisciplinary
sciences addressing problems in the field of energy, environment, quantum materials, nano-devices,
and chemical biology.

INST brings together biologists, chemists, physicists, materials scientists and engineers having
interest in nanoscience and technology. INST scientists, having strengths in basic science together
with more application oriented mind from different backgrounds, work together by joining hands as a
cohesive unit, under a congenial work environment, on a common platform apart from carrying out
their individual research. The aim is to generate processes, technologies and devices directed
towards national priorities especially in sectors like Agriculture, defence, healthcare, energy,
environment and water. INST encourages outstanding research resulting in publications in the best
internationally acclaimed journals , develop processes for strategic materials for indigenous
production (import substitution), generate devices and advanced technology for defence and for
commercialisation and also develop low-cost affordable devices especially in healthcare for the
socially deprived section of our society.

INST is also promoting science and inculcating the practice to develop technology in India amongst
the young generation of the nation through its Outreach program especially for rural, remote and
under-served schools by delivering talks in order to scrape out the hidden gems which when polished
may light up the natural and international scientific sky.
Through its various activity INST is committed to contribute significantly to the National Societal
Programmes like Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, Swasth Bharat, Smart Cities, Smart Villages, supporting the
Strategic Sector, Make in India and Clean & Renewable Energy through scientific means and by making
use of technologies to address requirements of these program.

### What is Nanotechnology?

Nanotechnology is science, engineering, and technology conducted at the nanoscale, which is about 1
to 100 nanometers.

Nanoscience and nanotechnology are the study and application of extremely small things and can be
used across all the other science fields, such as chemistry, biology, physics, materials science,
and engineering. The ideas and concepts behind nanoscience and nanotechnology started with a talk
entitled “There’s Plenty of Room at the Bottom” by physicist Richard Feynman at an American Physical
Society meeting at the California Institute of Technology (CalTech) on December 29, 1959, long
before the term nanotechnology was used. In his talk, Feynman described a process in which
scientists would be able to manipulate and control individual atoms and molecules. Over a decade
later, in his explorations of ultraprecision machining, Professor Norio Taniguchi coined the term
nanotechnology. It wasn't until 1981, with the development of the scanning tunneling microscope that
could "see" individual atoms, that modern nanotechnology began.

Today's scientists and engineers are finding a wide variety of ways to deliberately make materials
at the nanoscale to take advantage of their enhanced properties such as higher strength, lighter
weight, increased control of light spectrum, and greater chemical reactivity than their larger-scale
counterparts. Nanoscale particles are not new in either nature or science. However, the recent leaps
in areas such as microscopy have given scientists new tools to understand and take advantage of
phenomena that occur naturally when matter is organized at the nanoscale. In essence, these
phenomena are based on “quantum effects“ and other simple physical effects such as expanded surface
area. In addition, the fact that a majority of biological processes occur at the nanoscale gives
scientists models and templates to imagine and construct new processes that can enhance their work
in medicine, imaging, computing, printing, chemical catalysis, materials synthesis, and many other
fields. Nanotechnology is not simply working at ever smaller dimensions; rather, working at the
nanoscale enables scientists to utilize the unique physical, chemical, mechanical, and optical
properties of materials that naturally occur at that scale.

Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST), Mohali (Punjab), an autonomous institution of the
Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India, has been established under the
umbrella of NANO MISSION, initiated by DST to boost research and development in the field of
Nanoscience and Nanotechnology in India. INST started its activities on 3rd January 2013 from its
transit campus at Mohali, Punjab

## About Us Section

[Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam logo]
[Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav logo]

Institute of Nano Science and Technology (INST), Mohali (Punjab), an autonomous institution of the
Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India, has been established under the
umbrella of NANO MISSION, initiated by DST to boost research and development in the field of
Nanoscience and Nanotechnology in India. INST started its activities on 3rd January 2013 from its
transit campus at Mohali, Punjab

## Engineering / enjəˈniriNG /

The action of working artfully to bring something about

Engineering is more than machinery and code.
It's about intricate mechanisms that create astounding innovations. Interesting Engineering helps
readers understand these complex systems.

# About Us

At Interesting Engineering, we publish the latest scientific breakthroughs, technological
innovations, and more. Besides being a news publisher, we create daily and weekly newsletters,
release merchandise for engineers, record in-depth podcasts, and create courses to benefit our
readers.

# The battery-powered vessel challenging shipping’s dependence on fossil fuels

Tasmania’s all-electric ferry demonstrates how advances in batteries, charging infrastructure, and
vessel design are bringing zero-emission shipping closer to reality.

[Read Next: Manufacturing’s next giant leap isn’t another robot; it’s the factory itself][83]
By[Srishti Gupta][84]
[Case Studies][85]May 31, 2026 12:16 PM EST
[Copy or Share][[Facebook]][86][[LinkedIn]][87][[X]][88][[Reddit]][89]
[[Google News Preferred Source]][90]
By[Srishti Gupta][91]
May 31, 2026 12:16 PM EST
[Copy or Share][[Facebook]][92][[LinkedIn]][93][[X]][94][[Reddit]][95]
[[Google News Preferred Source]][96]
[The battery-powered vessel challenging shipping’s dependence on fossil fuels]
Hull 096 (conceptualized image).Incat/IE

In a landmark for clean maritime transport, Tasmania’s Incat shipyard has built the world’s largest
all‑electric ferry – a 130 m catamaran (Hull 096) for Uruguay/Argentina operator Buquebus. The ship,
named *China Zorrilla*, can accommodate 2,100 passengers and 225 vehicles in its 130 m length and
runs on a Corvus Energy lithium-ion battery system with a capacity of 41.2 MWh, reaching up to ~25
kn service speed through the utilization of our electric motors (4×2,400 kW).

Due to the fact that there is no combustion process, there is zero exhaust emission from the vessel.
It is planned to be commissioned during 2025-26 in Hobart (Derwent River), and will enter service
running ferries in South America. This case study highlights the technical specs, operational
profile, and broader impacts of Tasmania’s electric ferry—arguably a harbinger of shipping’s
clean-energy future.

## Technical overview

This Tasmanian ferry is a 130 m aluminum catamaran with a 31.5 m beam, built for high-speed
operation in shallow waters. The ferry is entirely electrically powered, with eight battery packs
(~5,016 modules total, weighing 250 tonnes) providing >40 MWh of power. Four 2,400 kW electric
motors (two each per hull) are coupled with steerable and thrusting waterjets with an output power
above 25 kn. Incat collaborated with Wärtsilä and Corvus Energy to install the system. It offers
some 90 minutes of endurance (~30 nm/55 km) in one charging cycle, enough to perform its ~1-hour
ferry run between Buenos Aires and Colonia del Sacramento. Charging itself takes about 40 minutes
per station (using land-based chargers). (Tasmania generates its electricity almost exclusively by
hydroelectricity and wind power and, thus, produces almost no CO₂ emissions.)

# The engineering behind Europe’s first 3D-printed concrete bike bridge

A Dutch team combined robotic concrete printing, prestressed hollow beams, and custom materials to
build the world’s first 3D-printed concrete pedestrian bridge.

[Read Next: Manufacturing’s next giant leap isn’t another robot; it’s the factory itself][83]
By[Srishti Gupta][84]
[Case Studies][85]May 15, 2026 10:31 PM EST
[Copy or Share][[Facebook]][86][[LinkedIn]][87][[X]][88][[Reddit]][89]
[[Google News Preferred Source]][90]
By[Srishti Gupta][91]
May 15, 2026 10:31 PM EST
[Copy or Share][[Facebook]][92][[LinkedIn]][93][[X]][94][[Reddit]][95]
[[Google News Preferred Source]][96]
[The engineering behind Europe’s first 3D-printed concrete bike bridge]
The 26-foot-long Gemert bridge across the Peelse Loop Canal, the world's first 3D-printed concrete
bridge, was inaugurated in 2017.TUe/IE

A pedestrian bridge composed of 3D-printed concrete components has been installed in Gemert, the
Netherlands. This is the very first bridge of its kind ever to be constructed anywhere in the world.
It was designed in such a way that it would be comprised of six lattice-like beams, which were
prestressed end-to-end. In doing so, the researchers were able to cut down on their consumption of
materials by nearly 40 percent, without compromising any of their design objectives.

“The bridge is not very big, but it was rolled out by a printer, which makes it unique,” [notes][97]
TU/e professor Theo Salet. Its 800 printed layers of reinforced, pre-stressed concrete now carry
hundreds of cyclists a day. The bridge demonstrates a new, lighter approach to low-carbon
infrastructure, cutting waste and CO₂ by depositing concrete only where needed.

The 26-foot-long Gemert bridge across the Peelse Loop Canal, the world’s first 3D-printed concrete
bridge, was inaugurated in 2017 when local authorities and engineers crossed it for the first time.
The bridge was printed in segments and assembled using standard abutments and tensioning cables with
a design life comparable to traditional bridges.

Although the bridge is engineered to conform to Dutch building standards, there was a significant
reduction in the quantity of cement used: 3D printing “uses far less concrete, which saves
resources,” as observers have noted. This reduction in the use of cement is very important since
cement manufacturing accounts for about 8 percent of all CO₂ emissions worldwide.

## Engineering / enjəˈniriNG /

The action of working artfully to bring something about

Engineering is more than machinery and code.
It's about intricate mechanisms that create astounding innovations. Interesting Engineering helps
readers understand these complex systems.

# About Us

At Interesting Engineering, we publish the latest scientific breakthroughs, technological
innovations, and more. Besides being a news publisher, we create daily and weekly newsletters,
release merchandise for engineers, record in-depth podcasts, and create courses to benefit our
readers.

# About us

### Ivermectinkart: Affordable healthcare for a healthier you.

At Ivermectinkart, we firmly believe in the transformative power of accessible healthcare. Our
mission is to establish a seamless and secure platform that empowers individuals to conveniently
access the medications they require, ensuring their doorstep delivery. We are dedicated to upholding
the highest standards of quality, affordability, and personalized service, positioning ourselves as
your steadfast partner in your journey towards optimal health.

[Pharmacy Shelf Medication]

#### About Ivermectinkart

Welcome to [Ivermectinkart][11], your reliable destination for high-quality healthcare products,
prescription medicines, and wellness solutions. At Ivermectinkart, our mission is simple: to make
safe, affordable, and trusted pharmacy services accessible to everyone.

We believe that good health is the foundation of a better life. That’s why we focus on delivering
genuine medications, health education, and customer-first service—all in one secure online platform.

[Doctor checking a patient's blood pressure, reflecting Ivermectinkart's commitment to trusted
healthcare]

#### Who we are

Ivermectinkart is an online pharmacy and healthcare information platform dedicated to helping
individuals manage their health with confidence. We work with licensed suppliers and follow strict
quality standards to ensure that every product we offer meets safety and authenticity requirements.

Our platform is designed for people who value:
* Transparency in healthcare
* Easy access to medicines
* Trusted health information
* Privacy and data security

#### What we offer

At Ivermectinkart, we provide a wide range of healthcare solutions, including:
* Prescription & non-prescription medicines
* Chronic condition support (diabetes, heart health, respiratory care)
* Wellness and preventive health products
* Immunity and nutritional supplements
* Educational health content and awareness guides

Our goal is not just to sell products—but to support informed and healthier choices.

#### Our Commitment to Safety & Quality

Your safety is our top priority. Ivermectinkart follows industry best practices to ensure:
* Authentic and verified products
* Secure ordering and data protection
* Clear product information
* Responsible healthcare communication

We do not promote misuse of medicines and encourage customers to consult licensed healthcare
professionals whenever necessary.

#### Why Choose Ivermectinkart?

✔ Trusted online pharmacy platform
✔ Customer-focused healthcare approach
✔ SEO-verified health information
✔ Easy navigation and secure checkout
✔ Commitment to ethical pharmacy practices

We continuously improve our services to match evolving healthcare needs while maintaining compliance
with regulations and guidelines.

#### Our Identity as a Global Online Pharmacy

Ivermectinkart is a full-service pharmacy e-commerce site which serves customers from several
regions. We concentrate on purchasing products from verified suppliers as well as established
manufacturers to guarantee security, authenticity, and the sameness of.

Each product we list on our website has been selected carefully, taking into account quality
standards and the requirements of customers. Our platform was designed to assist those who need
reliable access to medicines without requiring a lot of effort.

#### What Makes Ivermectinkart Different

Unlike generic online stores, Ivermectinkart is built specifically for pharmaceutical and healthcare
needs. We understand that medicines require responsibility, accuracy, and trust.

Our core strengths include:
* Broad range of pharmaceutical and healthcare categories
* Secure online ordering and encrypted payment systems
* Discreet and confidential packaging
* Worldwide shipping with reliable logistics partners
* Clear product descriptions and transparent policies
* Dedicated customer support for order-related assistance

#### Customer-Centric Approach

At Ivermectinkart, customers come first. We believe a successful online pharmacy is not just about
product availability but also about service reliability and communication.

Our customer support team is trained to assist with:
* Order confirmations and tracking
* Payment-related queries
* Shipping and delivery information
* General product assistance

We aim to respond promptly and professionally to all customer inquiries.

#### Our Mission & Vision

Our mission is to create a trusted global online pharmacy platform that delivers pharmaceutical
products efficiently while maintaining high standards of ethics, safety, and customer satisfaction.

We strive to simplify access to healthcare products by combining technology, logistics, and customer
support into one seamless experience.

Our vision is to become a recognized name in the online pharmacy and pharmaceutical supply industry,
known for reliability, quality, and customer confidence. As we grow, we plan to expand our product
range, improve delivery networks, and enhance the overall user experience.

[Vision and Mission concept representing Ivermectinkart's dedication to affordable generic
medicines]

#### Moving Forward

Ivermectinkart continues to evolve with the changing needs of the healthcare and pharmaceutical
landscape. We remain committed to innovation, quality assurance, and customer satisfaction in
everything we do.

Thank you for choosing Ivermectinkart as your online pharmacy partner. We value your trust and look
forward to serving you with professionalism and integrity.

Our customer care team is always ready to assist you.

The company offers a wide range of prescription and non-prescription medications, chronic condition support services, wellness products, and educational health content, catering to patients with chronic health conditions and health-conscious individuals seeking reliable health solutions and information. all_classified.company_summary: Karmaka is a specialized company dedicated to meteorite research and analysis, offering valuable insights into meteorite falls and their significance for planetary science. With a focus on studying various meteorite types and their implications, Karmaka serves a diverse market of researchers, educators, and enthusiasts interested in the cosmos and the origins of celestial materials.

# About Us

Advancing
Care with
Patient Focus
[About Us]

We, at Lupin, are committed to delivering healthcare solutions that prioritize the needs of the
community. Our solutions span across diverse segments, including generics, specialty medication,
biosimilars, among many others. We create an impact on 100+ global markets. As a global
pharmaceutical organization, we are focused on operational excellence, quality outcomes and
sustainable growth.

[The Lupin Story]
[Icon]

## The Lupin Story

Founded by Dr. Desh Bandhu Gupta in 1968, Lupin began as a simple but powerful idea, that quality
healthcare should be accessible to all.

What started as a small, determined venture has grown into a global pharmaceutical leader. This is
the story of how that belief took shape, gained momentum, and became the Lupin you see today.

[Read More][101]
[Our Purpose]
[Icon]

## Our Purpose

We Catalyze Treatments that Transform Hope into Healing

Ours is a purpose-driven journey of over five decades, where we relentlessly aim to improve lives,
build sustainability and deliver long-term value to our stakeholders.

[Discover More][102]
[Our Values]
[Icon]

## Our Values

At Lupin, our values guide how we think, act, and make decisions everyday. They create a strong
foundation for consistency, trust, and accountability across the organization. This shared framework
helps us act with clarity and purpose while navigating a dynamic global environment.

[Know More][103]
[Our Leadership]
[Icon]

## Our Leadership

We are guided by a team that brings experience, vision, and a shared commitment to growth. Our
leadership team helps us create an impact, innovate, and bring meaningful change every day.

[Learn More][104]
[Global Presence]
[Icon]

## Global Presence

From a single vision in 1968 to an organization that moves across borders, Lupin has grown into a
network of 24,000+ people across 11 countries and six continents.

[View our Global Network][105]
[Our Manufacturing Approach]
[Icon]

## Our Manufacturing Approach

Our manufacturing strength is built on the power of technology, advanced facilities, rigorous
quality systems, and a commitment to sustainable, reliable production. Our Global Technical
Operations team combines manufacturing, procurement and supply chain entities to offer efficient
healthcare outcomes.

[Explore More][106]
[Quality in Action]
[Icon]

## Quality in Action

Quality is the foundation at Lupin, guiding every step from research to delivery. We uphold the
highest standards of safety, efficacy, and compliance globally. Our commitment to quality helps us
deliver high-quality medicines worldwide.

[Read More][107]
[Our Science]
[Icon]

## Our Science

Our scientific expertise and commitment to innovation drive our pursuit of advanced pharmaceutical
solutions. Our capabilities span the organization, including our R&D and Digital Transformation
teams, enabling us to explore new frontiers in science and healthcare.

[Learn More][108]
[Awards and Recognitions]
[Icon]

## Awards and Recognitions

Our efforts to deliver high-quality pharmaceutical solutions have earned several laurels across the
healthcare ecosystem and the communities we serve.

# The Lupin Story

Five Decades of Transforming Healthcare

Our Founder, **Dr. Desh Bandhu Gupta**, aspired to build quality healthcare as a right for all. He
believed that scientific excellence is imperative to expand access to affordable healthcare. This
relentless drive to pursue a single dream led to the formation of a company that would go on to
impact several lives through affordable, accessible healthcare.

[Dr. Desh Bandhu Gupta]
[Dr. Gupta and team at early Lupin facility]

After completing his post-graduate studies in science, Dr. Gupta chose a path that went beyond
academia. While teaching at the Birla Institute of Technology and Science in Pilani, Rajasthan, he
recognized the urgent need to translate scientific knowledge into practical solutions for public
health.

[Lupin early operations and community health focus]

From its very inception, Lupin was envisioned as a company that would place community health at its
core. Lupin started operations as a manufacturer of vitamins and soon started producing drugs to
combat tuberculosis.

[Lupin's first manufacturing facility]

Lupin’s first manufacturing facility focused on producing iron and folic acid tablets for the Indian
Government’s flagship maternal and child health program. These early efforts laid the foundation for
what Lupin continues to stand for today: Science-led innovation guided by compassion, purpose, and
commitment to improving lives.

[Lupin Foundation and community development]

I have the conviction that only by doing selfless service to the needy and the poorest of the poor,
one can achieve a true sense of satisfaction and happiness; the highest purpose of life.

— Dr. Desh Bandhu Gupta

Guided by this belief, Lupin’s commitment to social responsibility took an institutional form with
the establishment of the Lupin Foundation. Lupin Human Welfare and Research Foundation is dedicated
to rural development and community well-being, translating our founder’s philosophy of selfless
service into a sustained movement.

[Decorative petal]

## Did You Know?

### Lupin was named after a flower

The Lupin flower grows even in harsh conditions and enriches the soil around it. Inspired by its
resilience and selfless nature, Dr. Gupta envisioned a company catering to others, addressing unmet
medical needs despite on-ground challenges.

### An auspicious beginning

DBG founded Lupin in 1968 with the help of INR 5,000 borrowed from his wife, Manju Gupta, who is
currently the chairperson.

### Our first breakthrough

The Government of India entrusted Lupin with supplying iron and folic acid tablets for its mother
and child healthcare program. This was Lupin’s first major order and a foundation for the future.

### A team of two

Lupin started with only two employees: a peon-cum-packer and a part-time typist. This is a powerful
reminder of how great things grow from the simplest beginnings.

## Our Milestones

Journey of Care Shaped by Courage and Conviction

From 1968, Lupin’s journey has been defined by a belief that science can be a potent catalyst for
change and transformation. What began as a small, determined venture grew step by step, milestone by
milestone, into a global healthcare leader touching millions of lives.

# Our Values

[Spirit of Lupin]

## Core Values That Define Us

At Lupin, we pride ourselves on our promise of caring for our customers, our commitment to our
employees’ growth and welfare, our continuous quality focus, and the spirit of innovation that
drives each of us to discover better ways of working. This culture is shaped and driven by our
values.

[Decorative element]
[Integrity]

### Integrity

We conduct ourselves with uncompromising integrity and honesty, upholding the highest standards of
ethical behavior and transparency. Everything we do must stand public scrutiny.

[Teamwork]

### Teamwork

We align efforts across levels and geographies to deliver outstanding results. We encourage diverse
opinions and work together in a coordinated and mutually supportive way.

[Passion for Excellence]

### Passion for Excellence

We relentlessly pursue excellence through innovation and continuous improvement in all our projects,
processes, and products. To set our standards,we benchmark with the best in the world.

[Entrepreneurial Spirit]

### Entrepreneurial Spirit

We empower our employees to generate new ideas, explore avenues, and offer solutions that add
exceptional value. We encourage ownership with responsibility, passion, and conviction.

[Respect and Care]

### Respect and Care

We are compassionate and sensitive towards all our stakeholders and treat them the way we expect to
be treated. We provide equal and fair opportunities for employment, learning, and career
development.

[Customer Focus]

### Customer Focus

We strive to understand and meet customer needs in a professional and responsive manner, building
long-term partnerships for mutual benefit.

# Compliance, Ethicsand Governance

We instituted P.L.E.D.G.E. (Preparing Lupin Employees to Demonstrate Governance and Ethical Conduct)
to reinforce our robust governing principles. P.L.E.D.G.E. drives the culture of compliance by
enforcing a common code of ethics. It empowers employees to report unethical practices and
institutes specific mechanisms to deal with any form of workplace harassment.

Good business requires honesty, integrity, commitment, transparency and trust - the pillars of
stable governance. These values form an indivisible part of Lupin’s culture and help us uphold our
promise of caring for our customers. These values constitute an integral aspect of Lupin’s corporate
culture and support our commitment towards caring for our customers.

They shape the way we conduct business and how we interact with our clients, employees and the
community at large.

As a responsible corporate citizen, we strongly believe in the power of ‘right,’ which means doing
the right things, in the right manner, at the right time.

Our policies and procedures promote accountability to all stakeholders and support our commitment to
the highest governance standards. We are an equal opportunity employer dedicated to fostering a
safe, empowering, and inclusive workplace environment. We have zero tolerance for corrupt, illegal,
unethical or immoral practices and adhere strictly to established norms of ethical, moral, and legal
conduct.

*Lupin fully complies with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations &
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, ensuring strong and transparent corporate governance.

Making Affordable Healthcare Accessible Globally

Lupin has expanded and grown manifold since its inception in 1968. We have operations in 11
countries across six continents, allowing for safe and reliable delivery of medicines to our
patients across 100+ countries.

[India]

## India

Lupin's journey began in India, when Dr. Desh Bandhu Gupta (fondly called DBG) established the
company in 1968. From one facility in Aurangabad in 1979, the company now has 15 state-of-the-art
manufacturing facilities across the country. Scientists and R&D personnel at the company's two
research centres in Pune and Aurangabad leverage cutting-edge technology to provide unique
solutions, including those in the field of high quality affordable biosimilars. Along with the
commercial enterprise, DBG also founded the Lupin Human Welfare & Research Foundation, which
promotes holistic rural development in India.

[Read More][114]
[USA]

## USA

Lupin Pharmaceuticals Inc., established in 2003 in Baltimore, Maryland, currently has five offices
along the U.S. East Coast with its salesforce across the country. Lupin is present in the U.S.
through manufacturing, research and development, and commercial divisions for generics, complex
generics, biosimilars and branded pharmaceuticals. In 2015, the company set up the Center of
Excellence for Inhalation Research in Coral Springs, Florida. Subsequently, it acquired Novel
Laboratories, Inc. to create Lupin Somerset — its first manufacturing facility in the U.S. In
2017-18, Lupin achieved a milestone when U.S. revenues crossed $1 billion.

[Visit Website][115]
[UK]

## UK

Lupin Healthcare, our subsidiary in the UK has a portfolio consisting of high quality generics with
a focus on anti-retroviral and oral contraceptives. In January 2019, we launched our first set of
medicines in the neuromuscular space for the UK market. The entrepreneurial spirit, external focus,
and pipeline strength, transitions Lupin in the U.K. from a standard generics business to a more
specialist organization that partners with the NHS to deliver value.

[Visit Website][116]
[South Africa]

## South Africa

Pharma Dynamics, our subsidiary in South Africa, is committed to expanding access to effective,
affordable healthcare and helping create a healthy future for all South Africans. Our quality
generic medicines offer patients cost savings of up to 70%. We also invest in various wellness
programs to support patients on their journey to holistic wellness.

[Visit Website][117]
[Australia]

## Australia

Generic Health, Lupin's subsidiary in Australia, is among the fastest growing pharmaceutical
companies in the country. It is a leading provider of high-quality generic prescription, injectables
and over-the-counter medicines, supplying to pharmacies and hospitals across Australia. We are
committed to supporting the health and wellbeing of all Australians through our comprehensive
product range, competitive pricing, and healthcare expertise.

[Visit Website][118]
[Philippines]

## Philippines

Multicare, Lupin's subsidiary in the Philippines, is among the top five branded generic companies in
the country. It is committed to providing high-quality products that enhance healthcare for patients
and deliver greater value for medical professionals. Multicare strategically focuses on therapeutic
areas and specialties, and has established a reputation in women's health, especially in their
journey to becoming mothers. Other areas of focus for the company include rheumatology, respiratory,
oncology, neuroscience, diabetes, gastroenterology, pediatrics, and nephrology.

[Visit Website][119]
[Germany]

## Germany

Our subsidiary in Germany, Hormosan, focuses on offering innovative drugs through to generics for
affordable treatment of various acute and chronic diseases. We have made constant progress in select
therapy areas including rare diseases in neurology, pain management, sexual health and HIV. As a
pharmaceutical company, Hormosan is an integral part of German society, contributing optimal,
guideline-compliant care for patients through medication.

[Visit Website][120]
[Netherlands]

## Netherlands

Nanomi, our subsidiary in the Netherlands, is a leader in the field of microsphere and nanoparticle
manufacture and development of long-acting release medicines. Its proprietary Microsieve technology
guarantees cost-effective, highly controlled and reproducible production of these medicines. Through
Nanomi, Lupin's mission is to become a global leader in the field of complex injectables and
introduce a wide portfolio of branded and generic products in key markets.

[Visit Website][121]
[Mexico]

## Mexico

Laboratorios Grin, our subsidiary in Mexico, is currently dedicated to the development,
manufacturing and commercialization of ophthalmological products, proteolytic enzymes, oral
antibiotics and antivertiginosis, among others. Its focus areas include visual health, food
supplements, respiratory diseases, algology, male health and angiology. Products manufactured here
are exported to seven countries in the region.

[Visit Website][122]
[Brazil]

## Brazil

Medquímica, Lupin's subsidiary in Brazil, is one of the most prominent pharmaceutical companies in
the region, manufacturing drugs that are high in quality, reliability and safety. Here, we
manufacture solid and liquid medicines for five focus areas: over-the-counter (OTC), similar drugs,
hospital, generics, and dietary supplements. Like every other Lupin manufacturing site, quality is
of utmost importance and the Medquímica site has been awarded the certificate of Good Manufacturing
Practices (GMP).

[Visit Website][123]
[Canada]

## Canada

Lupin Pharma Canada Limited, established in Toronto and Montreal in 2014, is the Canadian subsidiary
of Lupin Limited. We are committed to strengthening our branded product portfolio with the launch of
additional medicines developed from our own research and manufacturing process, as well as through
strategic brand acquisitions and licensing.

[Visit Website][124]
[France]

## France

Medisol is Lupin’s subsidiary, headquartered in Paris, France. Founded in 2011, the company
specializes in generic injectable medicines for hospitals and pharmacies across the country. Through
Medisol, Lupin offers a portfolio of seven injectable products spanning four therapeutic areas,
including pain management, anti-inflammatories, cardiovascular diseases, and obstetrics.
